This is a 2016 Chevy Silverado 5.3, and it runs on unleaded, bad ideas, and the Constitution 🇺🇸
Built in AMERICA, assembled in Fort Wayne, Indiana, by people who punch clocks hard, talk trash louder, and don’t own skinny jeans.

The 5.3 V8 ain’t trying to impress California — it’s here to haul, tow, idle loud at gas stations, and scare Priuses into switching lanes. It sounds like freedom with a slight drinking problem.

The transmission went through a phase… like your cousin who “found himself” and scared the family. But it got fixed, re-educated, and put back to work. Now it shifts solid, keeps its mouth shut, and does what it’s told — like a man with a mortgage.

Fires up every morning without whining, doesn’t need a safe space, and doesn’t apologize for existing. If you want something delicate, emotional, or fuel-efficient — keep walking.

Overall, the app is normally responsive and fairly easy to use. However, I do get annoyed by the constant prompts to trade in my vehicle or check its value. I understand that it’s a free app and they need to find ways to make money off their work. I’ll continue using it unless they start charging for it, in which case I will have to reconsider. CARFAX Car Care.title: Good idea, poor execution, keeps getting worse.
CARFAX Car Care.body:
I like the idea of this app. I use it to keep track of maintenance on all my family's vehicles and the fact that they automatically populate (most times) is super helpful. However, there are numerous bugs and downfalls. 

Oftentimes it will get the most recent service for an oil change/tire rotation/tire replacement wrong and give you the wrong service reminders. This isn't because the service wasn't reported, the app just sometimes thinks that "tires balanced" (or similar) means that the tires were replaced too and you have to go in there and correct it yourself. That seems like a silly little error to me. 

They also seem to keep taking away features with updates. Now in the "glovebox" the VIN is partially obscured, why? I need my VIN for things and I used to be able to go right here for it. I can't see title/ownership history past my own ownership anymore, including everything before I titled my car in a new state, even though everything before that was me, as it's 1-owner. Why are you taking away features???? That's not how updates work!!! I suppose it's to encourage car shoppers to buy an actual report and not get by with the app which shows a good chunk of the info that would be on a report, but maybe if your reports weren't FORTY DOLLARS for ONE REPORT more people would buy them.  

The most recent issue I'm facing is that a member of my family just titled their car in a new state, which I did with my own car a little while ago, and now the app keeps asking me "do you still own this car?" and no matter how many times i click "yes", it will continue popping up and their car is not on my app. I don't want to bite the bullet and press "no i dont own it" because I have a bunch of manually entered data for that car going years back that I don't want to lose. I kind of wish the app just worked and there weren't all these bugs in the first place! To be fair, it doesn't help that the state we changed our car titles to has reported it both times to carfax as "new owner reported" when the owner is the exact same as it was before, just at a new address/in a new state. Can't wait to contact the DMV and deal with that. 

Oh yeah, and it seems like only 1/3 of the time does a shop put service records in correctly. I have had records with incorrect mileage, showing work that didn't happen, not showing work that did happen, etc. It almost makes me wish I never downloaded the app, because I'm realizing that Carfax may not be all that reliable and it's annoying having to go through support to get records corrected. Carfax is a great idea but it is just so flawed. You would think they would have it figured out, being around as long as they have.

I spend more time in the app trying to close out their pop-ups and get their stuff out of the way by resetting there maintenance warnings that I do not want. I'd much rather pay pay a yearly or a one time fee for the app that if I can just put in the data and create the settings that I want.

CARFAX Car Care.body: Great app, but it lacks common sense. What is the point of logging the price of fuel, if I can’t get a year consumption report, along with cost. Same goes for maintenance. It would be nice to have a financial feature to see the cost of ownership, by time or distance.

CARFAX Car Care.title: Love it
CARFAX Car Care.body: Nice to be able to log all our vehicles’ maintenance in one place.  Also allows you to rate shops.  The maintenance notifications are particularly helpful specially for busy people like us.

CARFAX Car Care.title: Really helpful
CARFAX Car Care.body: I’ve been using this app to track maintenance on all 4 of our vehicles, and it’s really helpful. I used to keep a spreadsheet but the ability to upload receipts to this app made this the killer car maintenance app for me. I only wish that there was a way to make owner-performed maintenance part of the actual Carfax report, but at least I can print out the receipts for a future prospective buyer. It’s worth mentioning that with aircraft, owner performed maintenance that’s properly logged is considered part of the official maintenance log for the aircraft. Seems the same could be true with cars, but that’s a minor point. The app is still very useful.

CARFAX Car Care.title: Customer service slower that frozen molasses
CARFAX Car Care.body:
Three weeks ago I had attempted to have service done on my 2024 Kia at Walmart. They were unable to complete the services I wanted on 26 Oct 2024. Walmart accidentally put in the wrong mileage, they added over 20,000 miles.  Two days later I had the service done at a different Walmart where the correct mileage was entered. Now when I try to correct the mileage or enter service, I get an message my mileage has to be above the incorrect mileage now showing.  CarFax/CarCare has been notified with the correct mileage showing on the receipt. For 3 weeks now I have been getting emails saying it is under review. It should not take that long to look at the history see the error. 
anyone have a better app to use instead of CarCare?

CARFAX Car Care.title: Worth it
CARFAX Car Care.body: It’s handy to attach simple services you may perform on your vehicles to document maintenance history. Very simple to use. And a benefit if you’re ever planning on reselling your vehicle. Mechanic shops use it and you can to with everyday DIY maintenance to show a record of care.

CARFAX Car Care.title: I love using CARFAX ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
CARFAX Car Care.body: I love the fact that I can update my CARFAX of any DIY projects that I do to my car or even go to a service center that isn’t link with CARFAX that I can update it myself. This is one feature that I tell a lot of people about that come get their oil changed at my place of work, a lot of people don’t know that you can update CARFAX on your own so I do spread the word to let people know that they can to update CARFAX not just service centers. They definitely like the fact of knowing they can do that especially mechanics that work on cars themselves.It makes sense. Makes sense.

Well, time came that I was out of town and needed a copy of a receipt - I went to the app, only to find that the app saves only very low resolution copies of the receipt photos you attach. So much so that the most of it is illegible! The app also doesn’t save a full-resolution copy of the photo you take to your photo roll. So, out of luck. 

App developers, please fix this!

CARFAX Car Care.title: Can be frustrating
CARFAX Car Care.body: This application is good for trying to keep up on maintenance but also tries to guess or assume where you are in mileage on your car and continues to add miles on your car whether you are putting them on or not. If you don’t review this you cannot fix it later. So you can have CarFax showing your car has 5,000 more miles than it does in reality and throws a wrench in your maintenance. On top of that getting an issue fixed is a task. Sent request and received emails for almost 2 months saying case was in review. Then finally got response saying VIN was incorrect and they would like me to start all over again. There’s an O where I should have put a zero. With the information they provided me they easily could have seen what the correct vin was and resumed but instead would like me to start from square one because of assumption their application makes that you personally can’t fix. Frustrating.

But two things found need fixing:
1) license and state fields not saving entered data
2) garage dashboard screen should allow OPTION to show upcoming service reminder by mileage NOT just by time (months) remaining.  I would prefer miles on front garage dash screen as most service is mileage driven, not time. Yes next screen shows both but why force the extra work going deeper. Allow the option on dashboard screen. 

Great app. keep up good work. looking forward to improvements

Hopefully in the future, more automation will be possible, look forward to it. Great apps, simple and does what it need to do.

Car Maintenance Reminders.body: Apparently the author is a car person who knows what’s really needed and what’s not. Awesome app! Deleted carfax.

Car Maintenance Reminders.title: Handy app
Car Maintenance Reminders.body: Works good and a great tool

Car Maintenance Reminders.title: Excellent App with Smooth UI and a Handy Suggestion
Car Maintenance Reminders.body:
I downloaded this app today and instantly fell in love with it! The user interface is great—smooth, simple, and incredibly intuitive. Navigating through the app feels effortless, making it a pleasure to use.

One suggestion I have is to enhance the history section by showing the maintenance items that were completed, (along with their corresponding icons) on the outside as well. This addition would make tracking past services even more convenient.

Highly recommend this app for anyone looking to keep their car maintenance organized!

Car Maintenance Reminders.title: Awesome app for tracking
Car Maintenance Reminders.body: Love this! I like how you can change/add/delete maintenance items by car since they’ll have different service requirements. Would be nice to have a “master” list so you can edit the interval presets/defaults, then when they are added to a new car you don’t have to go in and update again. Would also be nice to go straight into adding a maintenance item from the overdue screen.

Car Maintenance Reminders.title: Cars Disappear
Car Maintenance Reminders.body: I eventually deleted the app. I would have my car in there and randomly I would open the app and there were no cars listed. I read my car and everything is fine again except I had to start over. Then it would happen again randomly. It’s happened about 5 times. The last time I got a notification that my car was due for maintenance and I opened the app yo see no cars listed once again.

Car Maintenance Reminders.title: Chefs Kiss
Car Maintenance Reminders.body: I was wanting an app with exactly this functionality. I’m really glad I didn’t need to write it myself :)

Car Maintenance Reminders.title: (Almost) perfect app
Car Maintenance Reminders.body:
This app builds on the idea of the popular "Road Trip" in the App Store, but gets updated by a cleaner weekly reminder for an odometer reading. Road Trip requires adding each vehicle fill up to stay up to date, but the problem there is when two people share a car, it's very easy for someone to forget to add it, throwing things off. This app keeps it simple.

The main thing lacking (and I would update to 5 stars) is iCloud sync. In 2024, I'm dubious of any app that doesn't have some way of backing up data, especially because data loss has been reported by other reviewers. Nothing else would need to be changed about the app, but some way to backup and sync data would make it a 5-star app for me.

Car Maintenance Reminders.title: Intuitive and Useful
Car Maintenance Reminders.body:
Exactly what I was looking for! Interface is very intuitive. I like the reminders feature based on time and mileage. 

I had a small issue with data sync and had reached out to the developer. Got prompt response which helped resolve the issue.

Car Maintenance Reminders.title: Super easy to use car maintenance tracker.
Car Maintenance Reminders.body: I’ve found this to be easy to use. Hope future updates continue.

Today, when I opened the app to update my car’s mileage I saw that all maintenance records had disappeared.  Even my car information was gone.  I will be moving on from this car maintenance app to a more reliable one.

Car Maintenance Reminders.title: Good Program
Car Maintenance Reminders.body: I was looking for a program to track my maintenance on my vehicles. I tried a few and liked this one the best. This program allows you to enter multiple maintenance items in one service (which most of them don't). The layout of the program is very simple and easy to use. You can change or add services to fit your car and also change the service time peroids It allows you to track multiple cars and gather a fair amount of data on your cars. One thing I would like them to add is service center. So you can track who worked on your car. This program works very well, but could be more extensive.

Car Maintenance Reminders.title: Great Application
Car Maintenance Reminders.body:
Great application, this is exactly what I was looking for. It’s clean, simple and stores data locally. A few opportunities to improve; 1. Add an “other” category; some reminders that are added may not fall into the ones already provided. 2. After selecting miles as the unit of measure, when editing the distance for reminders the unit still reflects as kilometers this should reflect miles.

Update**

I recently opened the car maintenance application and all of my car maintenance records have been wiped - this is without updating the application. The only thing that was done recently was update to iOS 17.0.2

Car Maintenance Reminders.title: Great App!
Car Maintenance Reminders.body:
Loving this app. It’s everything I want that’s missing from CarFax Car Care. It’s got super customizable reminders and records which has been a huge pain point with Car Care. One thing I’d love to be added is pdf attachments for records and iCloud backups for data. All of my records are pdfs and screenshotting them to add them to the app is a bit annoying.  Backup is also super important since I’d hate to have all of my records and reminders disappear with an app update. 
Also if the dev ever wants to stop making updates. Pleaseeeee make this open source. I need this app to stay up and up to date forever. Thank you so much for this.

However, I was saddened when all of my data and custom reminders were wiped clean after an update. I am more than happy to change my rating if I can recover this data.

Car Maintenance Reminders.body:

Is there any way to do “retro” records with the original date?

Car Maintenance Reminders.title: Great no frills app
Car Maintenance Reminders.body:
I love the similarity to the native iOS Reminders app interface. Simple. No unnecessary user accounts, data collection, or subscriptions. 

Similar to a previous review, I would love a way to export data as a .PDF or .CSV for backing up or sharing maintenance history with someone. I was using the “Auto Care” app for years, but it has evaporated from the app store recently. Luckily I have the exports that app allowed me to make. 

It would also be great for the “Additional Comments” field to be a user defined service title, and an additional long text field for detailed service notes. 

Are those possibly in the future?

Those two items aside, bravo. Very grateful for what this app already is. Thanks!

Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.title: Long time user
Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.body:
I’ve used Fuelly for well over 10 years.While I find the interface easy to use for the most part, the thing that drives me crazy is the repeated loss of commonly used gas stations from the map of available neaby locations. Over the years I have experienced the repeated loss of the local Costco gas station. It seems that whatever API the developer is using to populate the mapped locations is inconsistently updating or deleting available locations.  I have written to support a couple of times and the first time I did so the issue was resolved shortly thereafter. However, the same issue has returned and the last support request was unsatisfactory in that there appeared to be no available resolution. In addition, I’ve experienced a significant number of gas stations in my travels that just aren’t available in the maps. Some are new, some have been around for years. There is an ability to manually list stations and select from that list, however there is no way to sort the list or remove unwanted entries.

In summary I like this app and have paid the annual fee each and every year for a long time, but this will be the last year doing so unless the above issues are resolved satifactorily. At this point I think the “developer” is just milking the cow.

Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.title: Love the app!

And for three, when typing notes in an entry, the screen isn’t scrolling down properly, so text starts to type behind the keyboard and you can’t properly move the screen upward to view it. You can only pull it up, then it bounces back down. So the app is getting glitchy and overdue for a visual and functional update.

Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.title: Was 5 Stars - Now Login Issues
Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.body:
I have been using this app religiously since 2012 across multiple vehicles and even a boat (mostly for boat maintenance tracking). The app randomly says I need to login, but it doesn’t allow me to login when I enter my credentials. I’ve also tried the “forgotten password” link but I never receive the password reset email. I know it’s the correct email address because I’ve used the same address for 20+ years. I have so much information stored on the this app and want to continue using it but it’s becoming very time-consuming dealing with login issues when I simply want to add a fuel-up and get back onto the road. 

Additionally, please improve the search feature for gas stations. I often need to manually enter the gas station address for gas stations more than ten years old (not a new business).

Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.title: Features
Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.body:
My wife and I have been longtime users. We had the original app before Fuelly purchased it. Fuelly has neglected the app for too long. The app does not automatically sync across devices or users. The location of fueling or service is not searchable, editable, or sortable. Duplicate entries cannot be merged. Fuelly customer service stated they are working on significant upgrades to the app. Unfortunately, they are unable to give a timeframe for when a new release will be available. 

My wife and I continue to use the app. We have been unable to find a similar iPhone/iPad app. If we did, we would give serious consideration to switching.

Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.body: Changing my rating to 1 star because you cannot add a missed fuelup without deleting all of the fuelups after it. (The "Last odometer" field is autofilled and you cannot change it manually. Therefore the mileage calculation will be WRONG.)

Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.body: This app has been so helpful across so many cars I’ve owned for years!

Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.title: Why the watered down version?
Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.body:
I used to have an android phone and got an app called aCar. It was great. When I switched to an iPhone I went looking for the same app. I found Fuelly. It had the same logo. Made by the same developer.  It’s the same app or so I thought. I got Fuelly. It is good. All my records transferred over. 
Then I started to notice that some of the features of aCar were missing. Fuelly seems to be watered down version of aCar. Same price less features.

I ask: why water down a great app?

For example, when you enter your fill up on the same screen it will say you increased 1.5mpg since last fill up but then right below that it will say -1.5mpg. Contradicting the other number. Please update this app or sell it off. If we’re still paying annually for this I would expect at the very least two updates a year.

Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.body: I just changed from an android to an iPhone, and found my fully app had a fraction of the functionality on iOS.  Why, Fuelly, why?  I can only see fuel and service records now?  How incredibly disappointing that it’s missing all the other stats! Please consider expanding the iOS app to match the android version, especially the total cost of ownership. I liked tracking every non-service purchase/mod to my 4Runner.

Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.title: Fails at basic math
Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.body:
I’ve been using the app a while now and it does not appear to track MPG correctly.  The simple math is divide the miles traveled since the last fill up by the gallons needed to fill current fill up.  I fill up to full every trip to gas station and the number it calculated is off.  

This has potential to be a great app if it could simply do what it was designed to do- track mpg.  I love all the features but the app is pretty much useless when it can’t perform simple arithmetic.

Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.title: Good, but could be much better
Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.body:
First of all, it’s the best app to track vehicle fuel and maintenance costs. However, there’s no real competition and the bar is low. It seems like this app has been forgotten about.

My biggest gripe is choosing the date of the entry. There’s no calendar, and no way to select the year, month or day individually. You have to scroll through all the dates. I’m trying to enter receipts all the way back to 2017 and it’s been taking an eternity. 

The second thing I’d like to see is more graphs for tracking fuel. The only graph at the moment seems to be MPG on the fill up date. I’d like to see MPG at certain mileages as well. Maybe a few other graphs/layouts, but I can’t think of anything else right now. 
Edit: another graph could be price of gas at each date, or price of gas at each mileage. 

Also, a lot of cars track engine hours and average speeds for each tank. It’d be nice to have a few other things to be able to enter on each fill up. This wouldn’t even clog up the entry form because you can select/unselect items you want to track. 

All in all, it feels outdated. If you try to find information on what the premium subscription gets you, it brings you to a page that was last updated in 2019, and it doesn’t even tell you. Premium IS worth it though. $7.99/year is affordable and I definitely wanted to be able to upload pictures.

While I find that frustrating as a user who already invested the advertised price into this app, I get the capitalistic nature of the subscription model for app developers and their overhead for continuous development. - 1 Star: My main annoyance with Fuelly is its regular advertising for premium subscription-based features upon app startup. I’m not even trying to access those features. I get interrupted using the features I’ve already paid for with the ads to pay for more. Makes me want to find another app, but I’ve got so much history with Fuelly that it would be time-consuming to migrate elsewhere. Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.title: My Favorite Automotive App
Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.body:
Back in the olden days, I watched my dad write down the mileage and gallons at each fill-up. I never could get in the habit of using a paper notebook, but keeping it in my phone is great. I’m two years into using Fuelly and I can’t imagine not having it. It’s more than just fuel and mileage info, it’s also a record of maintenance. I love that I can take a pic of my receipt at the pump, or the itemized invoice at the mechanic, and log exactly what was done. Then a few months later I can look at my notes when the shop tells me it is time to replace my spark plugs and I can say no thanks I had that done less than 10K miles ago. 

If I could change anything it would be the export function. All the images are lost, which stinks if you ever want to sell your vehicle and include the service record. Also, the tire size and recommended pressure aren’t viewable on the car info page. If you hit edit you can see the fields and edit them, but otherwise they’re invisible. Devs, if you’re reading, consider updating. 

Both are minor issues and don’t outweigh the overall usefulness of this app, especially for the very reasonable annual fee. If you’re looking for a place to store your vehicle data consider Fuelly.

The only way to get past the screen is to enter login credentials I don't have, so I go to the website and create an account, then enter it back into the app. Low and behold, ALL MY DATA IS GONE. They somehow made it mandatory to sign in remotely without an app update, then forgot about their customers who never created an account, and neglected to create any way to migrate local data to cloud, resulting in permanent data loss. 

Also, no response via email or Twitter. In fact the support email for Fuelly bounced. So, there's not much else to say other than for me to ask you to please don't waste your time with this app. It's either shut down and/or the developers stopped caring even after taking people's money. They give small dev shops everywhere a bad name. Invariably you will find get-rich-quick d-bags who don't give a crap about customers or products, and will do super shady stuff like copy your clipboard contents without warning, which by the way there is absolutely no reason you need that. Be better people and get out of this industry.

With my Impreza, I wanted the extra layer of “double-check” to compare against, especially since I’ll be keeping it as long as it lasts.

Enter Fuelly.  This little app is super easy to use and has the added bonus of automatically pushing updates to Fuelly’s website where other users can compare results. I’ve already recommended it to several other people, including my family.

That said, if you’re looking for a paperless MPG tracker that has a free version with all of the basic features you’re likely to need, you owe it to yourself to check this app out!

Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.title: Does not save the station info
Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.body:
I’ve been using this app for at least 7 or 8 years with several cars. It’s only glaring issue is that it will not save the location details for the station where you’ve gassed up. I like to visit the same stations on my frequent long trips. The app is great at recognizing your location, almost always placing the actual station I’m at at the top of the selection list - but here’s the problem: IT DOES NOT SAVE THE LOCATION DETAIL. Yes, it will save the station name (Circle K, Shell, 7Eleven, etc) but not the street address, city, interstate exit, etc.

I use this info to project where I need to fill-up while on long trips. I prefer certain stations (truck stops) so I exported the stored data for my current car. That’s when I discovered the location details are missing from the export and it is not visible in the record in the app either so it’s totally gone. 

I suspect that the information is kept in some manner though and probably used by the developer to sell to research and marketing low-lifes. So why can’t me, the developers most valuable asset, get this info that I’ve painstakingly provided and(I thought) I saved?

Also, my most frequently used station (local Costco) is no longer listed in available locations when I select the location field. I created a “custom” location and do you think it is ANYWHERE near the top the of available locations list? What a crazy idea. Oh, and of course the location only saves the name, not the address SMH. 

And finally, it’s been a year or more since the app was updated but now the subscription price is increasing by 13%!

Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.title: It's ok, but irritating for vintage cars
Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.body:
I had previously used (and paid for) Gas Cubby, which was an awesome tracking app. After being acquired several years ago by Fuelly the old app was retired and replaced -and my history auto-loaded into the updated, inferior app. Time marches on, and I had hoped the new app would eventually surpass the old one, but it has not. It's prettier, and has some nice features, but I most often use the app when I'm filling up the tank and that's when a missing minor UI tweak gets to me - almost every time I use the app. 

I drive a vintage car without a trip counter and the odometer has rolled. The old app would show the last odometer setting and even had an option to enter the miles by spinning a set of dials that looked like the odometer - literally updating the odometer by spinning reach digit. It was fun to use and was difficult to get wrong. With Fuelly, I type in the number fresh each time - I have to remember to add a 1 (soon it'll be a 2) in front of the number every time. Thankfully, at least I get a warning when I miss type one of the major digits - but a minor UI change to either show the last odometer reading (in fixed width font for easy comparison) and even an auto-calculated field for "miles since last" would make this radically easier for me to use. I suppose I could just pretend that the reading is lower and go from there, but I have 12 years of logs that predate the odometer rolling.

It's a petty, stupid, but irritating thing that bugs me almost every time I use the app. Now Fuelly is periodically prompting me to subscribe, so I've started looking for something better, but haven't found it yet. 

Even though I initially bought Gas Cubby specifically because it didn't require an online service or subscription, If they made this minor change to support vintage car owners like me, I'd happily pay the small annual fee to use their service to keep the app going.

Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.title: 1 Glaring Flaw...
Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker.body:
I’ve been using this app for years now...  long before it was taken over by Fuelly (can’t remember the old name, but remember the wooden looking logo). Anyway, this app has helped tremendously in tracking the true cost of ownership of many of my cars, and I’m therefore pretty anal about entering the info for accurate results. 

Herein lies the flaw...  due to the new format, and it’s need to sync (to what?), the last time I opened it I noticed a sync error on one of the entries from my last road trip. It said duplicate entry and, after toggling between the two I saw that it was right. I went into edit and hit delete. Nothing happened. I did it again. Now BOTH entries are gone! The problem is that there is now no way to put one back, and my 24-27 average mpg vehicle is now showing a best of 61 mpg!  My world has not ended, but I will never have an accurate account of this vehicle now as a result. There should be some way to insert a missed record, but there isn’t. Even though I can change the date, the “last mileage” is always the true last one recorded, and is blocked out from editing, so inserting one would jack up the history even more. This is something that needs addressed by the developer. Otherwise, this was a 5 Star app. 😞

My third request was answered, but the representative who responded could not understand my issue. I explained it again he/she responded with an unrelated answer. I won't be renewing my subscription. Drivvo - Vehicle management.title: Insufficient unless you shell out $$$
Drivvo - Vehicle management.body:
Downloaded this based on reviews, but unless you are willing to get the version that requires a purchase, it's not worth your time. The font is TINY and the ads are HUGE and frequently take over your entire screen. When you enter the type of service performed on your car, it only offers a few types of service, and there is no way to add anything not already on the list. When viewing the timeline, it abbreviates everything so you can't see the full list of things serviced. You also can't download a paper version of the info you enter manually without paying for the upper level service. And, if you wanted to upload a photo or copy of a receipt, etc, you cannot download that without paying for the pro plan.

What is the point of a free app if you have to pay for every single little thing it is supposed to offer?

Drivvo - Vehicle management.title: Intrusive adds, reduced features

Drivvo - Vehicle management.title: Deceptive Pricing
Drivvo - Vehicle management.body:
I thought I’d give Drivvo a try and take advantage of the $11.99/yr annual special pricing advertised in the App Store. I tried to upgrade from within the app, but the only available annual plans were $49.00 or $419.00. I contacted their email support and was told that they are not honoring any special pricing, despite the discount being advertised in the App Store (which it still is). But they then asked me to write a review, so…

Looks like a pretty good app, despite having very limited data storage in the Pro subscription (for receipts/document pdfs) of only 250MB, unless you upgrade to the Fleet 10 plan for $419.00 (gulp) which only offers 1 gig. Pass.

My Car - Vehicle Manager.title: TRULY FRUSTRATING!!!!
My Car - Vehicle Manager.body:
When you start a trip the app knows the day and time…however when you go to close the trip with the ending mileage the app still reads the starting day and time. The app needs to change to current day and time EVERY time we open the trip window which will save a BUNCH of time! Another needed fix… when you fill in the Notes when starting or closing a trip, the app doesn’t start the sentence with a capital letter! What program on earth doesn’t know to start a sentence with a capitalized letter? And…let’s say you forget to add a service like new tires I purchased a month ago and decide to add it at a later date…NOPE! The system won’t allow you to add a mileage that is less than the most recent mileage as in when I bought gasoline yesterday. This app truly has some amazing problems that you would think would be easy to fix!

Update: Note when trying to add a reminder, the app won’t allow me to add a reminder from the past!!! in other words, I want to add a reminder at the mileage 102,219 and I’m over 103,000 now…OMG this app is SO BAD, it has motivated me to make a mileage tracking app that works!

There are m only two things I would improve if I could. 1) the fields don’t save prior entries, so I have to re-type the name of a gas station or repair shop each time I fill up. That’s annoying because a drop down menu would be much faster and convenient. 2) a family account should allow more than two people to use the app without upgrading to a business fleet account. My Car - Vehicle Manager.title: Useful
My Car - Vehicle Manager.body:
Great app. Keeps simple records of your car events that you can’t remember. Gives useful data about fuel consumption. This was the easiest app to get going. Works okay as-is, I opted to upgrade to the basic to add a few more descriptions, only a few bucks and worth it. 
Best is the filter on events. I add service events with multiple things done like oil change, oil filter, rotate tires, etc. then when you want to see when your last oil change was, apply the filter to list of all events and it not only shows you the last but any and every event with an oil change. Makes it really easy to see when, where and what was done. Keeps costs too and totals reports by month and year with averages. May seem silly, but over time this becomes more useful data.
I’m just having fun entering every refuel to see how my vehicle is preforming and also watch fuel prices over time. 
Has many other features.
I really found the layout very easy to read and understand how to use. Great app.

My Car - Vehicle Manager.body: This app has evolved to be one of the best purchases from the App Store.  I look forward to future updates.

My Car - Vehicle Manager.body: After about 40 minutes of fumbling through this app I was finally able navigate it.  This app is not user friendly or intuitive.  Once you discover how to use it I believe it is quite useful, but a real chore to set up.

My Car - Vehicle Manager.title: Add premium services to the iOS app
My Car - Vehicle Manager.body: Love this app, just needs the premium service like the windows version

My Car - Vehicle Manager.title: برنامج ماي كار
My Car - Vehicle Manager.body: من أفضل البرامج واحسنها في هذا المجال.

My Car - Vehicle Manager.title: Keep up the good work!
My Car - Vehicle Manager.body: Thank you so much for the best car related expense management app on iOS! It’s easy to use and offers just enough features. Thanks again.

My Car - Vehicle Manager.title: Just a simple maintenance record
My Car - Vehicle Manager.body: It could be so much more if the pro tools part worked. The way it is it is just a record. The reminders are not customizable.

My Car - Vehicle Manager.title: Welcome to iPhone!
My Car - Vehicle Manager.body: I've used this application for years while on windows phone.  When I was forced to move to an iPhone, I was disappointed to believe I would have to find a new app for tracking fuel and maintenance.  Since this app is new to the world of apple, it does not yet float to the top of the list of search results.  Make no mistake, Markku has been refining the functionally for years on other platforms.  Five stars!

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Easy to use
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: App is easy to use and customize the info you want to track as well as add notes

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Great tracker
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: I track all the things with this app. I love it and always look forward to improvements.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Terrible
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: I was really looking forward to using this app to track my maintenance across three vehicles. However, it is not very intuitive to learn, and on top of that, the free version doesn’t allow you to upload receipts, which is one of the main reasons I got it. Finally, the app doesn’t seem to be built for Apple as the formatting is off and it just doesn’t seem to work well.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Lost data
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: Lost 4 years of data on two vehicles!  Nothing over a year old remains!

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Great tool
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: Use this for all of my vehicles (6) still have records for ones that I’ve let go, but great insurance

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Crashing on Launch
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: Unable to use now. It worked fine last week but this week it’s crashing on launch.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Easy Breezy
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: A wonderfully simple and straightforward app I use to track all maintenance on my vehicles. Easy 5-star rating from me.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Unresponsive thief. Buyer beware
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: I bought the gold version and used it on the web, so I know it registered.  At some point in time I noticed that the app was saying I could buy the gold version.  I contacted the developer from the “Contact Us” page on his website on 4/16 (it’s 5/7 today) and didn’t hear anything back. I sent another contact today.  If the developer responds to me I will update this review.  Until this is resolved, be VERY careful.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Good app, using since 2018
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body:
It’s a very good app to log the maintenance and refueling. Using this app since 2018 for 3 different vehicles.
Just one note: every time I log in a partial tank fill up, it shows a mileage of 61 kmpl. I don’t what’s the algorithm here but this affects the average mileage  report as well.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Quit
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: Is this for years suddenly just quit working

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Can’t export data
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body:
I have a platinum account and linked to my gmail. However because the app/service has not updated how they communicate and authenticate with Google and now I cannot do a backup to export data. The report feature also does not work as it reports 0 records found.

Support seems to be nonexistent contacted several times.

At the point where I am going to have to manually copy all my data out entry by entry.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Disappointed
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: I have been a faithful customer of SimplyAuto app. I upgraded to the top-of-the-line membership about over a year ago. I’ve been using the app for about 5 years. I have dropped my phone at Dillon Reservoir on a fishing trip, I got a new phone couldn’t download all my information and I went and reached out to SimplyAuto and I’ve never gotten a response and I have reached out to them 5-6 times I use this app for record keeping and reminders of maintenance that are coming due on all my 8 vehicles and ever since I have upgraded to the platinum version I have never ever heard from them very disappointed what a waste of money and all the time of putting in my information for nothing.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Great app—watch back up on Google
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: Great app—watch back up on Google.  Lost 2 years of data

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: No reminders unless you pay
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: Nothing is really free. You have to pay for reminders

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Calendar problem
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: When I pull up the current month calendar I can’t see all the dates of the month.  The last row of dates doesn’t show.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Not good
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body:
I started using paid copies of Simply Auto years ago on Android, and it was pretty good. My two basic needs are to keep my eye on mpg (for vehicle health) and to track business miles (as a self-employed person).

Sadly, recent versions of Simply Auto on iOS are really not good at all. The mileage reports are full of errors and wrong math, and it takes some spreadsheet work on the mileage export to prepare needed records for the IRS. The data entry forms and especially any plots/analytics (such as mpg over time) that older Android versions of this app nicely provided are badly buggy or don’t work at all.

I may stick with this app for 2026 or find a replacement. The basic challenge is that most competitors offer mpg plus a lot of maintenance-related cruft I don’t need, but not business miles - or business miles plus a lot of expense management cruft I don’t need, but not mpg tracking. Anyway, I am in the market.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Pretty good
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body:
I was looking for something like this.

You can keep track of your maintenance, fuel, expenses and more.

The app is free and the available options are enough for me, but if you want to take full advantage of all features a onetime fee of $9.99 is required.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Developer Unresponsive
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: The app seems okay.  I have contacted the developer twice and have never gotten an answer.  The last time was because fields I need disappear from the screen.  I have to rotate the screen to get the fields back.  This was the only one I found without a subscription, but I may look again even though I bought it.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Needs work
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: I can’t comment much on the app’s features because the text is far too small to read. It doesn’t follow the device’s font or accessibility settings, which makes it difficult to use. I hope a future update addresses this, as accessibility should be a basic requirement.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Great App
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: Logs my fuel consumption. That’s all I want. Other features probably work well too.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Works great less filling
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: Greatest thing since peanut butter, I’ve been using this for a few years now as a long haul truck driver I can’t say enough thank you

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: What happened to my pro version?
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: I paid for the pro version of simply auto and have been using it for a (long) number of years. While logging my last fill up earlier this week, I was bombarded by pops and annoying ads. My paid version has disappeared and I’ve gotten no response from support.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Needs Updating
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body:
Been using app for years, but needs update!!!! 

No updates for 3 years.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Only a Fair app
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: Does not calculate total cost correctly for gas fill up? Constantly need to overwrite that price! Searching for gas there are vacant results for as long as 150 miles spread!

Easy to use and the back up
Works well

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Google blocks access to Drive backup/restore
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: Manual backup/restore to Google Drive no longer works because of security requirements Google put in place in January 2025. With no current development for the app, this is very unlikely to be fixed. Time to find another app.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Little support
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: I like the function and features of the app, but there haven’t been any software updates in a few years. With iOS 18, it frequently refuses to open or opens and the crashes.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: In want of love
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body:
I wanted to love this app. I was hopeful that since I had saved money from another company purchase I would be satisfied. After using the app for a few weeks I am very unhappy. 

1. There is no usable documentation on how to use this app. 

2. When using my phone the input data is not saved. I tried to input a fuel fillup and none of the data was saved after 3 attempts. 

3. I do not want to use the desktop to sync data. 

If you have used separate apps for mileage and maintenance in the past but are thinking of combining to avoid using separate apps, I do not recommend this app. It is very cumbersome and I did not ever feel good using it.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Good app
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: Would be 5 stars if there was a way to delete an entry

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Questions Support
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: Stopped working after 18.3.2 IOS update. Now fighting to get data back, no response from support.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Helps me keep track
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: Very good. I like this app a lot

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Great App
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: Easy to use. Keeps me updated on my vehicle expenses.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Super Useful!
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: Great app that makes keeping up with car maintenance super easy!

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Won’t back up anymore.
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: Google says you can’t be trusted to have me back up to my Google account. It won’t let me.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Useful app but slow and buggy.
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: The app is useful but it’s slow and buggy. Hardly any software updates.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Not the easiest to use
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: Love the concept but this app is not the easiest to use. Log entry dates require time stamps and the dialogue box to enter time is not visible. Other screens do not close upon entry.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Ok
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: Ok

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Crashes make sure you save after every entry
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body:
I got the pro version and have multiple cars on it. The app works great when it’s not crashing. The problem is at times, the app will crash. If you don’t resync you will automatically lose all of your data since the app won’t reopen. You have to delete and reinstall. 

Then after you reinstall and resync what you saved, some entries will still be missing which is very frustrating. 

Also here a bonus tip: if you upload copies of your invoices into the app, on every resync the upload time gets longer and longer until one day the app will crash. Not sure why it reuploads invoices you’ve already saved but I stopped doing it

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Excellent way to keep track
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: I really appreciate having simply auto to track my fuel, oil and tire rotation. So simple and accurate.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Decent app
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: Okay app for keeping track of routine maintenance. Only problem I keep running in to is when I try to create a new entry for service, the app overwrites the most current entry which is a PITA.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Buggy and UI not friendly
