Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: Is this app still supported?
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: Have had this app for YEARS, have not had any issues until after updating my phone to iOS 18. Now when I open the app, it just freezes on the home screen. I thought maybe it was bad signal when I was at the pump, but I get the same thing even at home on Wi-Fi. Can’t even use it anymore because it’s frozen and unresponsive. Can’t log anything, can’t look at upcoming maintenance schedules, can’t do squat. Very disappointed in the devs for not keeping this app going.

Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.title: App DOA?
Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker.body: Is this app being maintained anymore? I’ve been using it for years and it no longer works with iOS 18. I can’t download the existing data and the website can’t be found. If not I need to find another app to use to track vehicle expenses.

Auto Care Kit.title: Great Car Maintenance app!
Auto Care Kit.body: Have been using this app for a while and love it! Very user friendly

Auto Care Kit.title: Great app!!!
Auto Care Kit.body: Great app. Easy to use. I keep track off all maintenance on my entire family’s vehicles. Great options to check for just regularly maintenance or if you’re a DIY mechanic. I love this app. I’ve had it for years.

Auto Care Kit.title: Best App I have Found
Auto Care Kit.body:
I have tried just about every mileage / maintenance tracker in the App Store and this one has been my favorite. It’s simple enough to use consistently but full featured. 

I would like to see the option to go ad-free, but honestly the ads are not intrusive as it’s just a small portion on the bottom of the screen.

Auto Care Kit.title: Requires CCard information
Auto Care Kit.body:
Deleted app because it requires CCrd info to use it…😡

Received an email from the developer said no Credit Card required…this a LIE, because even to test it for a limited “free” period a Credit Card is required… don'twaste your account imr with this app…

Auto Care Kit.title: Extremely frustrating
Auto Care Kit.body:
I had my data synced with Google and every time the app updated, half of my data disappeared and was unrecoverable. It even shows "Started Tracking on [whatever date]" multiple times and all old and new data just vanishes. It's random too because I'll have some logs still there, just not all of them. 

The whole point of this app is to keep a data log of repairs and service and it can't do that. Horrible app.

Auto Care Kit.title: Third time is the charm
Auto Care Kit.body:
I had another app that was very complicated and didn’t sync between devices.  I liked it ok.  Then, I searched for another and added all of the data from the previous one.  It was very complicated and didn’t save the data when I asked it to.  I could never figure out how to make it work

This is actually the fourth try, but three today.  This is exactly what I wanted.  Simple with a place to store important info in chronological order.  I don’t need to be reminded about routine maintenance, but I do want every detail to be recorded…every issue that goes wrong, every fender bender.  Thank you to Larry for reading my mind.

Bu the way, I am using it for trailers and golf carts also.

Auto Care Kit.title: Lost all data
Auto Care Kit.body: I’ve lost all of my data. Everything going back since 2019 on my car as well as records on two other cars are completely gone. Either a recent update wiped it or updating to a new phone dead. I’ve had it synced to my Gmail account since I started using this app many years ago and all my data is gone. I tried signing out and back into my account and nothing. I’m at a complete loss 5+ years of vehicle maintenance records and repairs gone. I trusted this app and now I’m left with no record at all.

Auto Care Kit.title: A lifesaver!
Auto Care Kit.body: A great way for a busy family with multiple cars to keep track of service and repairs!

Auto Care Kit.title: More options
Auto Care Kit.body: The app does as it says, but there no options for ac/heat repair or service. There should be a option to add options.

Auto Care Kit.title: Easy to use, Exportable logs
Auto Care Kit.body:
I like the interface of this app. It’s easier to use than another app I pay for (which includes great charts).  
PROS:  Easy to create and track multiple vehicles.  Easy to share logs to email as text or other formats. 
CONS:  Can’t get rid of ads.  Can’t add your own service options.  Since you can’t specify more than 1 Garage that seems like an unnecessary feature; the same information could be added to the entry page for a vehicle by having a field for Location Garaged.

Auto Care Kit.title: Misleading and worthless
Auto Care Kit.body: App claims to back up to cloud and sync accounts but is completely useless on Android. Cannot even sign in using Google on pixel 6a so rip data.

Auto Care Kit.title: I know it’s free and all, but…
Auto Care Kit.body:
It’s OK I guess; I’m looking for another because of the following:

1. No place for a picture of the vehicle in profile. I mean, if you needed a quick pic for PD if it was stolen, or wanted to show a pic to a wrecker driver while you stayed warm inside a 7- eleven– oh well! Tough bananas I guess… 🤷🏼‍♂️

2. Information on car, e.g. , color, maybe your address, (I live in a house- not a “garage”) a state to go along with your license plate would be good…

3. I’m a detailed oriented person- I document things like, “checked and inflated tires to 35 psi at Dingbat Carwash this date”, or “Added a crapload of windshield washer /de-icer at home today in the driveway”; even “checked oil- full at home today at 1645 hrs”… not every thing is a oil change or transmission swap! Need more on the drop down menus! You really need to spiff this app up some! I’m not talking about putting lipstick on a pig, but have some design finesse guys!

Auto Care Kit.title: Awesome
Auto Care Kit.body: Fast easy and convenient. This app is great.

Auto Care Kit.title: Items to consider
Auto Care Kit.body: Would help to have spots to add oil and air filter numbers perhaps 3 of each. Currently I put them in the notes

Auto Care Kit.title: Ads?
Auto Care Kit.body: There’s no way to get rid of ads.  I can’t use the app for that simple reason. Otherwise, it may serve others well.

Auto Care Kit.title: Multiple vehicles
Auto Care Kit.body: I like this app a lot I have four vehicles to maintain and its so easy to check what work got done on all of my vehicles. It’s very user friendly. Well done!!!

Auto Care Kit.title: Good help
Auto Care Kit.body: It is good, helpfully software. But I’d like to be able  add service items, for example brake fluid change.

Auto Care Kit.title: Great app
Auto Care Kit.body: Works perfect for what I need

Auto Care Kit.title: Oh so simple
Auto Care Kit.body: I like the simplicity of the app but one more thing I would like to have in a vehicle log is the ability to add images of invoices and receipts.

Auto Care Kit.title: Good but…..
Auto Care Kit.body:
I would like to be able to edit and add my own check lists. To be able to move and group vehicles together instead of just move down feature. A place to add part numbers would be ideal. The ability to add pictures, to add or take away (like add truck numbers, or put drivers name) from the my vehicle page, or the ability to have more than one garage. Maybe a notification that tells you when, let’s say, an oil change is coming up or it’s time to rotate tires, etc. 

I like the concept you have… it could use a few adjustments.

Auto Care Kit.title: Dumb
Auto Care Kit.body: It didn’t let me add to track my gas mileage and get notice when oil change due

Auto Care Kit.title: Good app to track car maintenance
Auto Care Kit.body: I used it to enter information on my car and service records.  Pretty simple to use.  Has the features I need.

Auto Care Kit.title: Simple and straight forward
Auto Care Kit.body:
Very simple and easy to use.

That said, it would be nice to attach photos of the service and/or the receipt. Before/after photos when applicable.

Auto Care Kit.title: Perfectly Simple
Auto Care Kit.body: Simple, easy to use.

Auto Care Kit.title: not working on my iphone XS
Auto Care Kit.body:
Added my garage and then a vehicle. then added service notes (all 4 tires replaced). added a note several times but cannot view any information I entered. 
For me, all the app shows is 1 page listing with my garage and 1 vehicle. clicked the support link in search of FAQs, website, a pdf —anything; the support link lands on the app’s twitter account which lists releases, updates etc. Wish it worked as it appears to be a very useful app.

Auto Care Kit.title: Great App
Auto Care Kit.body: I enter every service on my vehicles. Great to be able to look back at previous service records.

Auto Care Kit.title: Recent Troubles with Sync, and Lost Cars with History
Auto Care Kit.body: This seemed to work okay until recently. Added a new car and somehow it just added to the one device and not the other. Tried signing in and out of both devices. When adding the new car to the other device (manually) with the big plus, it somehow deleted the car that I had been tracking the service history. Frustrating to say the least.

Auto Care Kit.title: It’s fine, for basic needs
Auto Care Kit.body:
This is right up there with all the others in this apps category. It does job but doesn’t stand out from the rest. 

I want an app like this to be more intuitive. The VIN number tells you everything you need to know about a car. Yet even though I enter in VIN I have to still say what make, model, year. That should get auto filled based on VIN. 
And this app is missing Trim and color which others have. 
Photos of car would also be nice. 

As far as maintenance records go. Me entering in check boxes is not good enough if you ever need to file an auto warranty or insurance claim. They want receipts. An option to take a photo scan, like “Office Lens” iOS app by Microsoft does, of receipts and attach to the service record would be ideal. And ability to dump out to PDF of all records with images of receipts for a date range to use with insurance or warranty claims would also be ideal! 

My quest for the ideal Auto maintenance tracker app is still on going. This app unfortunately doesn’t fill the need for me.

Auto Care Kit.title: Nice when it works, but frustrating
Auto Care Kit.body: I like the simplicity of this app - and wouldn’t mind paying something for it - but it won’t let me add more than 1 vehicle and I’ve even installed what I think is the latest version.

Auto Care Kit.title: Clearing my garage
Auto Care Kit.body: After I added several maintenance items to my just added garage, I felt very good about the app.  I got out of the app and went back in later.  My car was no longer listed nor was the name on my garage. I re-added my garage and one car. Listed info again. Got out and went back into the app.  It cleared my garage again.  Moving on to the next app.

Auto Care Kit.title: Worked good but can’t add another vehicle
Auto Care Kit.body: Had this app for nearly a year. Very simple, easy to use for keeping track of every little (or big) thing you do to a vehicle. Problem is when I went to add a 4th vehicle it won’t “add”. I hope they fix it, this is a fine app and I want to use it.

Auto Care Kit.title: Ugh
Auto Care Kit.body: I just downloaded the app and before I could enter info on a single car it asked me three times to rate it. One star for now. Let’s see if the app works now.

Auto Care Kit.title: Really had hope for this app
Auto Care Kit.body: After downloading and setting up 2 vehicles fine, it will not let me add a 3rd vehicle. Is this by design or a bug in the app?

Auto Care Kit.title: Great App
Auto Care Kit.body: A simple, elegant interface partnered with a sleek visual design creates and app that helps me keep track of the maintenance checks that are easily forgotten. All of these small tasks can really add up and an app that helps record these tasks is invaluable. The app helps me know exactly when, for example, my last oil change was. 5/5 Stars. I definitely recommend this app to all car owners.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Pretty easy to use app for tracking multiple assets and customization for specific maintenance items. Quick customer service as well

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: $20 paid version gone?
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Works great but do not pay.  I paid and now I no longer have access to the paid content.  I guess they just want more money.  I refuse to pay more.  No where did it say yearly or subscription when I paid.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great for Automotive DIY
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I’ve been using this app for years now and it’s great to keep track of work I’ve done on my vehicles.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Lost All Records
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I’ve had this app for several years & very sporadically updated 3 motorcycles & 1 car with repair & maintenance notes. For some unknown reason, after not opening for several months, all records were gone (but pics remained). Customer service was responsive (hence 2 stars), but of no use because ultimately they couldn’t come up with any valid reason this happened. Idk. Use at your own risk I guess.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Four Cars Owned
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I have three vintage Mercedes and a Porsche Cayenne. Coming from the airline world, I am a stickler about maintenance records. Autoist is the perfect digital companion to hardcopy records.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I’m not a fleet manager but I was looking for a solid app to manage my own vehicles. AUTOsist looked promising so I decided to try it. I have to say that I am completely satisfied with the app. The main reason is the customer support. I had a couple of things come up and I emailed the help desk. Within minutes, they were back to me. That is amazing. I highly recommend this app.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app! Great Customer Service!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I’ve been using this app now for 8 years to track all maintenance related expenses on my personal vehicle. I love how easy it is to use and to stay organized, and the simplicity of attaching a picture of the receipt to each log I make. I pull up past receipts and odometer readings to gauge when something was accomplished and it helps me prepare for future maintenance.

I recently had a small technical issue with the app and emailed customer service. To my surprise they responded within 20 minutes and fixed it for me. 

I highly recommend this app to help keep track of your vehicles maintenance. Very useful in staying organized.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Terrible ipad support
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: The app need to be updated for iPad support. And the gmail log-ins always crap out.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great Customer Support
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I accidentally deleted one of our automobiles when only trying to delete an picture of it. Contacted support and they were able to restore all my records for it. 🙏🏽

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app and support
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I’ve been using AUTOsist for a long time to help keep track of my car’s maintenance and reminders. 
Today was the first time needing support. They responded quickly and helped fix the issue. 
There isn’t a better app out there.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: A great app and support service
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I have been using the app for over four years and I highly recommend it.  The only issue I had was a week ago.  The app wasn’t displaying my data.  I could access my data from a browser but not my phone.  I contacted support and within a couple of hours they emailed me and open a ticket.  Within a day or so my issue was resolved.  Their support is quick and thorough.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: App report function has an issue
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I’ve been logging service and uploading receipts for my vehicles for years into this app. When I ran the “Spend Analysis” report, I find that the data is completely wrong- shows no service after 2020 and shows thousands of dollars of service for 2009 when there is no services logged.

Customer service very responsive. They have identified a glitch in the app and are working to fix it. Their web portal is spot on however so no problems there.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great way to keep track
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I’ve had this app for several years and have always loved it. It’s simple to add things in, it gives reminders as I add fuel in. I just set how frequent I want the reminder- for oil or so, and it keeps track of the mileage every time I add in the gas for it. When I add the gas it also keeps track of trips, MPG, cost of fuel, it’s a really handy app. I have two cars of my own and it keeps everything simple, tracks the receipts to the repairs when I add them in. It’s also handy for project vehicles so I can have a list of what I’ve done/how much I’ve spent…per vehicle. I’m about to add my fiancés car, so we’ll see how well it helps with keeping up with a car I don’t drive every day. I imagine it will be great…if she just puts her gas In, but when it comes due, it will send me an email, in case she has forgotten to say something… I love this app. 10/10 would recommend. Especially if you have multiple vehicles. Helps keep things straight.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: 5 vehicles not enough for personal non-business use
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I have a generator, an RV, 3 motorcycles, and a truck. I like the app and have had it for several years. I do not understand why the developers have chosen not to provide a plan where the number of personal vehicles cannot be increased. I like the app enough to pay more but not the fleet rate. I’m currently looking for another app that will not restrict my use this way.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Amazing service awesome app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I had an issue where I was struggling to get signed into my app at a time that I really needed it. I sent an email to the support team and immediately received an email back the support team continue to go back-and-forth until my issue was resolved. They actually went behind the scenes and fixed it for me this was not a fault of theirs but mine. I would highly recommend this app

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Absolutely Best App for Vehicle Owners
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: The sterling reviews for this app are spot on. Downloaded almost two years ago, this app checked all the boxes for the criteria I had for items needed in an app to manage my personal minor fleet of multiple vehicles - car details, customizable service records, fuel tracking with automatic gas mileage calculation, custom maintenance reminders, notes and documents area, uploading photos, and more; it really does it all, and does the significant data management and heavy lifting effortlessly while maintaining clean appearance, modern style, and intuitive user interfacing. It made selling vehicles easier also, thanks to their share/transfer record feature, so auto information and records can be sent to new owners at the click of a button, making both person's lives easier and getting the new owner started right off the bat with intact records and a great app to continue the convenience of their newly purchased car's ownership. Never forget maintenance again, or confuse tasks due between multiple vehicles again, and have everything you need digitally for owning heavy machinery assets right at your fingertips on demand. I tell everyone looking for a maintenance program: go get AUTOsist!  Free for one car, and absolutely worth the reasonable one-time fee for managing five, and they have other options for enterprise or larger fleets. With a prompt responsive and knowledgeable support team at the click of a button for any app-related questions, cloud-backed up data, and also browser accessible so does not depend on your phone being alive or intact, this app is the ultimate one of any available out there right now, and my favorite and most used app on the entire app store. OUTSTANDING JOB team on the production of this app!!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Excellent Potential
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I believe this app has excellent potential to be my main personal fleet maintenance tracking app. The one thing keeping me back from giving this 5-stars is that the app is not well optimized for tablets, namely the iPad Pro 12.9 (gen 5). This device is my main productivity device. 

I hope that updates in the pipeline will address the iPad optimization.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I have been using this excellent app to manage my fleet of family cars for many years...today I expereinced a sign in with Facebook issue due to FB cahnging parameters. No worries, tech support to the rescue, excellent turn around time and problem solved! One of the best customer service experiences I have ever had! Thank you!!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great for record keeping
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I go through cars and it is always good to keep records of all your $pend as well as what maintenance has been done or what is coming up next. At the moment, I have 3 vehicles that I maintain and when I get tired of them I sell them. I am able to provide a maintenance schedulers, what has been done, and how much I’ve spent on maintaining the car for. This beats my old record keeping of putting all receipts in a binder.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Management made easy
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This is a great app for tracking all of my vehicles and their associated service. No longer do I have to keep hard copies and file them away. Instead, I take a pic and add it to my service records on the app. Additionally, the customer support was extremely fast and helpful. Thanks!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: My app is working!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: After 3 months my app always opened, then it required me to enter my email and password however it would not open.  I contacted support and spoke to Zane who was great and explained the error I was making and helped me to unlock the program.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Best auto maintenance app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I have been using this app for years. The other night I went to update my mileage. The app start have a problem with my service reminders. I emailed them and they got right back to me. This was at 11:30 at night. The next morning it was fixed. I never got service like this just for an app. Not even from Apple themselves.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Wasted Download
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Well the app downloaded but could not get an account created.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Works great
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
Great for keeping track of my family’s maintenance & repairs.
Terrific customer service.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Can’t be beat for maintenance records!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I’ve been using the app for a few years now to track all the maintenance on the 4 vehicles in our home. I use the fuel, services, and reminders all the time. Reminders are great so that I remember to check things between regular service intervals (my Jeep consumes oil so I have a reminder set to check the oil level every 1,000 miles for example).
When I have had questions about the app over the years, the developers are always incredibly responsive and helpful. The fact that you can log into the account online and have an interface to the data on the computer as well as the app is really helpful.  Top notch all around.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great customer service
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I keep all of our car records in the app as we do most of our own maintenance and it keeps us organized and on time. Whenever I’ve had a question or a concern (which is rarely - the app is great), the customer service has been quick and efficient. Highly recommend!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: AUTOsist
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
This app is outstanding. 
I just love it. Does everything I need and more.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Deleted my CarFax app - Awesome Program
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I used carfax maintenance tool for a while. Good product but no export features and a bit clumsy.

This product does exactly what I need. I’m a DIY car guy and track all maintenance, all mods, notes, tips and pictures when I fix things. Export to share with others etc. 

Fantastic tool.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: MyKingdom5NJ
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I had a question about how to do something in the app & emailed customer support to answer my question. It didn’t take long for a response back that did resolve my issue. Great job in your response time & resolution of the problem. 👍🏻

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Easy to use
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
This is a great app. Data entry is efficient and overall, it is intuitive and easy to use.  I really like the ability to photograph maintenance receipts so they don’t clutter up my glove box or get lost in some file drawer when I need them.  I drive a PHEV.  The gas mileage tracking feature has been fun to use for “neener-neener” purposes!

I’ve tried other maintenance tracking apps. This one is by far the best of the bunch. Definitely strikes the right balance between features and ease of use. 

I was amused by the reviewer who complained that the app looked abandoned because it hadn’t been updated in a long time. Hmm, if it ain’t broke, don’t fix it!

Stable, simple to use, cloud based making it easy when upgrading phones, free for a single vehicle, reasonable price for multiple vehicles. What’s not to like?

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This app is actually fantastic. I use it to track all of my repairs and I throw out the receipts etc that were stuffed in my glovebox. Take a picture, put it in the app, and toss them. Also great for seeing when my inspection is due and the same for oil changes. There’s also a report feature that gives you a summary of spend for each year. I’m always surprised by how much all of these little maintenance charges add up to! Highly recommend- especially for anyone that does their own repairs and wants to keep track of everything.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Document for lease or own
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I got this to keep maintenance records for a leased vehicle since I DIY and wanted proof for eventual vehicle turn-in.  Nice to keep track, save receipts and other images. Can then create a report at lease-end.  Easy.  Now I’m hooked for other vehicles, boat, etc.  AND customer service the one time I needed it was immediate and personal.  Nice!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Prompt Response
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I recently reduced the vehicles in my  Auto Assist “garage” and transitioned into/subscribed to their five vehicle plan. This resulted in two of my vehicles’ records being “locked”.

I contacted Auto Assist and within one half hour, they acknowledged/validated my issue, assigned my case to a customer service rep and indicated it would be addressed shortly.

As promised, my garage units were unlocked and I was fully operational within hours.

Over the years I have been a subscriber, this has been typical of the outstanding customer service I have experienced with Auto Assist.

This is a GREAT TOOL for keeping your records at your finger tips, especially when you are traveling.

A great CHRISTMAS GIFT IDEA !

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This app is a perfect for consolidating maintenance of multiple vehicles.  Previously I was manually recording vehicle maintenance history via Excel & setting reminders on my phone.  It was a very clunky way to keep history.  AUTOsist is a much better way to keep records & set reminders in a single location.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Updates are far and few between
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
As if this review 10/22/2020 there has not been an update to this app in over 1 year. And it was a year before that for the previous update. 
Doesn’t seem like the developer puts much time into this app. I tried to add my new car a 2020 and the year field which has you select the year only went to 2019. It does let you manually enter it but seriously why is t this app update at the very least quarterly?  
When I see apps with updates of year or more old I start thinking abandoned app, and if it’s free I wouldn’t care. But they charge for a Pro license to add more than 1 car. I have 2 cars. So this is not a free app. And for fleet use they charge a subscription! 

Developer. Please more updates and please add new features every once and awhile.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: This does everything I need it to do!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I wanted an app that would allow for details on my vehicle plus pics, maintenance records, reminders, mileage. etc. it has everything. It is very easy to enter vehicles & all the extra info and remembers what you have added in from previous entries. Highly recommend!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Streamlined efficient way to manage maintenance and prevent major issues!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Excellent
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Easy and powerful app.  This is the app you want.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Just What I’ve Been Looking For
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This app is perfect for anyone who wants to create their own electronic service records. You can write records for anything and keep information on your car like the VIN, license plate number, and even a picture! My favorite feature is being able to keep track of fill-ups and you can even write in what type of fuel you got, who you bought it from, and how much it cost. All for free! Very well done.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Get this App Now!!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
﻿I am an auto enthusiast that has 7 cars.  Most of my cars are classics that don’t get driven as often as I would like but keeping track of when I took them out, how long, service records, tire sizes, battery type and when it was replaced has taken all of the guess work out of managing my love of cars and ensuring they are all receiving regular and recurring maintenance to keep them operating optimally.  

User interface is very intuitive and has everything you need to keep track of all your needs.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Login?
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I just want to track oil changes and other maintenance so I know when to do it again.  I don’t need the cloud to access my data anywhere as I can look at my phone anywhere.  I don’t need fancy reports and I don’t need to track mileage as my car display already does that.  Like most apps, overkill.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great Tool for Tracking my RV Service
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Wanted an app to track service and repairs for my RV. AUTOsist is perfect for what I wanted to do. Not only can I record expenses and what was done, I can attach a picture of the invoices.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Had an issue with the mileage not being accurate from one gas fill up to the next. Contacted support and they got right back to me by email. I was able to attach a screen shot to the email do they could see the problem. Less than 24 hours the issue was fixed. Great team to work with.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Problems logging in
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I’ve had nothing but problems most time trying to get logged in. I use the app once a month. Whenever I reset my password, it won’t take the new one and I have to log in under Facebook or google which I don’t want to do...still looking...

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app keeping auto info/tracking in one place
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
Been using this app for a couple years now to track fuel/mileage, oil changes, service I perform and service at garages. Upgraded to track 2 cars and a truck. I also snapped picks of my bulbs and (liquid) capacity/filters pages so I don’t have to look up filter or bulb numbers when I’m at the parts store.  I also keep some other reference papers there and have reminders set for oil changes, inspections, etc.
Used customer service once and they were super fast. Had my issue fixed in under an hour.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app & helpful support
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Very easy to use app and is a great tool to store your cars records and keep maintenance records up to date. I had an account issue trying to gain access and their support team was very helpful and went above and beyond to do everything they could to help me.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I have been using Autosist for several years.  I love being able to track my fuel economy, service history (and cost), and mileage.  

I used to record mileage in the notes section but they’ve added a Trip Log feature now that makes it ever so much easier! 

The service records are great to have in the app - I no longer have to dig through notebooks full of papers (from which the specific document i required always seemed to be missing, of course!) to figure out when I last had something done.  It’s allon my phone!

I find tracking these things useful from both a business and a personal standpoint.  I highly recommend this app!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Very useful app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: We live on a small hobby ranch.  I use this app to track maintenance not only on my cars but also on my tractor and other motorized vehicles we use on our place. I love having all the info on all those vehicles available whenever I need it, including part numbers for filters and such.  The mobile app works very well and the desktop access is even better, letting me pull data to Excel to analyze my spending. I tend to keep vehicles for a long time so I have a lot of data for a non-commercial user. Highly recommended.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Useful app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This is a very useful app. I use it for my family vehicles including my motorcycle. It’s a great app that keeps all my info in one place and readily available wherever I’m at. I love that I can also access the info and create records from a laptop as well as using the app. It does take some time to setup but once it’s setup you’re good to go. One other thing I love is that you can print out vehicle reports. The reports contain all the notes, pics, and receipts I entered. Very useful if I ever have to file a warranty claim. One last item. The developers are responsive and helpful. My purchase was not showing up and the softwares wanted me to make a new account. I contacted the developer and they figured out that there was an error with my account due to trying to log in with Facebook but my purchase was done with a different email. They fixed everything on the backend and got me up and running, and I didn’t lose anything. I’m happy with this app. I recommend it for anyone that does their own vehicle maintenance.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Robust and well designed
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I like the feel and lay out of this app. It is very robust too. I like that I can add photos to entries. Also, it’s very intuitive. When I add insurance and enter expiration date, it asks me if I also want to setup a reminder for renewal. 

Very cool features.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Nothing tops this app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Hands down im gonna save everyones time and money this app beats every other car maintenance app out there. Its easy to use many options to customize. Everything i would of put or wanted from a car maintenance app this has it. I spent an entire afternoon downloading numerous apps and all failed to meet my expectations but this hit out the ball park. Get this app or dont get anything at all!!!!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Perfect app for a variety of vehicles.
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
For months I have been searching for an app that can meet all of my maintenance needs.   In my household this is a bit tricky because some of our vehicles do their maintenance in hours not miles (motorcycles). All the apps I have tried do one or the other but not both.  Most don't do either well.  

AUTOsist manages to do all of my standard requirements along with a bunch of other handy features like scanning receipts, keeping track of costs, having a digital wallet, etc.   It really is perfect for the home user.  

While researching this product I had some questions so I emailed their support team.   In less than 30 minutes I had my response and they answered all of my questions. Any company who has this level of support and a quality product has earned my money!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
AUTOsist
I was using a competitor's app for tracking Fuel and Service for my car.... always hunting and pecking to enter data.  It was difficult to use their app. AUTOsist is very intuitive and straight forward.  If it's easy to enter your data, the app is good.  And you can edit all this data on the web.  You can also upload receipts and pics.  I really like this app because when I go to fill up, it's easy to put the data in fast.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Go to app for tracking maintenance
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I had been using the free version for about a year to try it out. It does everything I need and more. I really like the ability to add photos for those items that are a little odd. It helps to nail down the outcome of the repairs I make. I have since upgraded to the five vehicle paid version. I highly recommend this app if you want to track maintenance and repairs!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: A Must Have App!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Prior to smart phones and applications like this, I kept multiple maintenance logs with paper and pen for each vehicle. The AUTOsist app has revolutionized my automobile maintenance bookkeeping. It allows me to keep track of all maintenance, and alerts me (after setting the necessary alerts) when time or mileage service is required.  I upgraded to manage each of my vehicles, and I’d recommend the same for other “do it yourselfers” with multiple automobiles. Additionally, if needed, the AUTOsist Staff offers exceptional and expeditious service to ensure you’re a “satisfied customer”!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Nice App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: It’s a nice app that does just what I needed.  I only wish I could add more vehicles.  I have motorcycles, ATV’s, and such that I’d like to track and would gladly pay, but it goes from 5 at a very reasonable price to $100 per month to track a “fleet”.  Uhh, no.  Can I just pay $40 for 10 vehicles?  If they changed the price structure, it would be more useful to me.  I’ll keep looking for a better fit for my situation.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Excellent app for the do it yourselfer.
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Use this to keep up with maintenance and repairs on all our farm machinery and personal vehicles. Allows you to keep up with intervals, what you’ve spent and allows you to make notes for future reference. Highly recommend

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Excellent App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Have had this app for over a year. Have had excellent tech support for the one sync problem I had. Can’t say enough about how good this app is at putting a mountain of vehicle info at your fingertips wherever you are plus be able to share that info with anyone who wants to know how well your keeping up the maintenance on your vehicles and back up all that info!!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Excellent
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Excellent app. Started using the free version and liked it enough to purchase. Easy to use. I primarily use it to track maintenance but also find it easy to use for fuel. The developers respond quickly and provide great customer service.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Very useful!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I have been using this app for a few years now to keep track of my different vehicles and their maintenance. It is extremely handy and I like how I can take pictures of the receipt that also helps me keep track of the costs and the shop. My phone recently updated and logged me out I went to login with my normal email and there was nothing no vehicles or anything in my garage. After panicking I contacted their customer support who emailed me back and the issue was promptly resolved. Definitely worth the upgrade.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: The app is good but lacking
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
Great concept; I REALLY wanted to migrate over from Auto Maintenance Pro to this, however the software  lacks the following

- uploaded images of receipts are very poor. They are clearly reduced once the upload has been completed.  This was a serious downfall

- Only one work performed entry allowed per line.  For example, “oil change” is a single entry.  Rotated Tires is another, and so on.  This seriously clutters things up.   

It would be helpful if the work performed could be multiple entries for the specific mileage—. Oil change, rotate tires flush transmission, etc instead of separate entries.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: No longer loosing my marbles!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I have a large family.  Our newest car is 12 years old and our oldest is 25.  Maintaining 6 cars has been a challenge.  AUTOsist works great for tracking the maintenance and keeping receipts and other information handy at a moments notice.  Well Done!  I have been using this for almost 3 years.  They are great at fixing bugs quickly too.  Very responsive.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Just what I needed!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I have kept really good records on my car since I got it a few years ago, but I wanted something that was easy to look through and sort through data, without having to make some spreadsheet. 

This is fantastic. Simple but with all the fields I need to enter my info. 

What I would love to see:
*Icons for the type of service for a quick visual cue (tire icon, oil change icon, brake icon, etc). I am currently saving clip art images and saving them as photos in the service data.
*Sort/search by services. Right now you can ascend/descend, but often I’m getting more than one service (i.e. oil change & new tires) and I’d like to search by services. (Not the end of the world... I could enter my double services separately.)

Overall I’m thrilled with this app. Great job!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
Currently really enjoying the app. It will help me keep track of what I have to do to keep up with regular maintenance. I also can record other service jobs I do which will help me sell the car since I can show buyers all the world that I’ve done to take care of the car. This app will also track how much your spend at the pump. So many cool things. I have 2 minors complaints giving this a 4 star instead of 5. 
1- this app will only track one vehicle for you and I had to pay $20 just so I could monitor my brother’s car too. 
2- the app doesn’t appear to remove notifications after you Mark a service reminder as “completed”. It’s a simple glitch I’m sure but I’m hopping the coding team can debug this in a recent update.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: This app is a cruel joke!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This app online app is worthless if you can't access it!  I've tried multiple times to update my password. It's says I'm successful and then the app still won't allow access.  P.O.S.!!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: The “go to” app for you vehicles
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I have been using this app for a few years for three vehicles. Records management is easy and straightforward. The attachment function is great for being able to provide an accurate detailed history. The other data recording of service performed and fuel tracking is spot on, easy to use, detailed and ease of use makes using the app a delight. Reminders and reports lets you manage your vehicles so you won’t miss maintenance requirements and in the event of selling the vehicle provides you the ability to show the prospected buyer details to help seal the deal. The attention to improve the app has been continuous and attentive towards the users. Try it!!!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Easy way to manage your vehicles. Support is great.  Highly recommend this app.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: 0 Star Rating
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Too bad I can’t give it 0 stars. Only after you create an account you realize that the free version only supports 1 vehicle and you have to pay for multiple vehicles. So if you have more than 1 vehicle look elsewhere.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: So far so good, but...
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Since my old app doesn’t work anymore in iOS 12, I went looking for a new app for my new car. This one seems to fit the bill except the TouchID keeps telling me that an account already exists but doesn’t log me into my own account. Also, TouchID doesn’t automatically come up like all other apps. You actually have to select this method just to get the message above. I will probably continue to use the app but will be frustrated every time I need to log in. Good job otherwise.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: AUTOsist is wonderful
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I do the maintenance on all of my families cars and the program is wonderful. Sends email alerts when oil changes, inspections are due. Tracks vehicle mileage and expenses. I purchased the Pro account which works great for my needs. This is the program you want!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great Support
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I have been using this application for a few years. However, I recently was unable to get into the app and thought my history was lost.  I think the problem may have been a result of a phone upgrade.  I called the support line to see if they could find my vehicle. Despite not giving them the best information to filter on - the support person was persistent and eventually found my history and restored it in my app.  Great app, great support.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Account Executive
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I used this “app AUTOsist “ to track my expenses , when I travel during the week to work.  It’s an excellent app,  it can track all maintenance done to my vehicles. like my motorcycle and my car..  Very useful, when you want to search, for any work that was done prior to any of my vehicles. Recommend this app to anyone interested in organizing,  their expenses. And maintaining maintenance receipts or records for any one that own one vehicle or vehicles!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: I’ve tried a bunch of these .....
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I’ve been through various apps over the last 9-10 years to track car maintenance and service records.   For me, this one does everything and does it best.   It has: 1) good interface, lots of attachment capabilities. 2) handles multiple vehicles (actually can handle fleets) with ease. 3) has a web interface I can use when on my computer - I really like this - and 4) the developers are quick to respond and fix stuff - A+

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Outstanding app and as important, customer service
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I own multi vehicles and keeping those records straight for each of these proved to be a real pain.  This app has solved those issues perfectly.   I can keep track of gas, mileage, maintenance and service.   
I wanted to point out that there was an issue with the app no longer calculating mpg and $$ spent on fuel.   One quick email through the app itself to customer service and it was quickly and completely resolved.   It’s great that this level of support still exists.  I was using a different app prior that ended up being abandonware.   I lost years of data when it no longer worked on my iPhone.   Happy to see that this app looks to be solid and support will be ongoing.   Thank you for putting this app together!!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I was looking for an App that I could track maintenance and repairs to my truck that would produce a report when I was ready to sell. This app fits all the bills! I can add receipts, it figures fuel usage, gives an expense report, I can add pics (receipts and parts), gives reminders for oil changes...AWESOME! I wish I could add more than one vehicle without paying additionally, but I get it, they’re here to make money. I’ve had the truck for 4 months and it produced a 50 page report!  I think the pics (receipts, repair pics of the intake manifold replacement) should be AT LEAST 2 or 4 per page instead of 1, it would make a smaller report. I would pay the $20 one time fee if I could get 2 vehicles and unlimited pics and entries . Now that I’ve started tracking I’ll remove the receipts that don’t affect warranty. But if it’s limited, I guess I’ll put the app for my wife’s car on my wife’s phone to get around it. But let’s face it, when the kids start driving I’ll probably just pay the annual fee to track what essentially would be considered a fleet. I’ve tried a couple of the other apps before this one. I’ve shown it to quite a few people. GREAT APP!!!  WELL DONE!!!! Very few apps out there that work EXACTLY as well as you expect them to, but this one certainly does! Download it. Try it. It’s free. You won’t be disappointed!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Too Expensive

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Easy to use!
