It tracks my fuel cost, calculates my MPGs, reminds me of service requirements based on mileage or date (3000 miles for oil changes, every 6 months for tire rotations, etc....).  Also allows me to add pictures of my receipts and parts that I install.  

Very useful app!  Highly recommended!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Too many flaws
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
Edit:  The APP forgot my login details. No excuse for this. 

Won’t allow entry without internet access, rendering useless in poor coverage areas. Uninstalled.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Customer service
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I panicked when I thought my data was lost only to realize I used a different email to create my account. This all after writing their help desk on Xmas eve...they were very responsive (within 30min) and made sure I figured out my issue. 

A great app and same customer service...

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app, great customer support
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I’ve been using this app regularly for the past year and find it incredibly helpful in keeping records of my fuel usage. It’s also been really useful having my car’s info easily accessible on my phone. And on the one occasion there was some confusion over my account, the quick response time and customer support was really impressive. The confusion was cleared up in no time and they were incredibly helpful and friendly. Great experience with this app all around.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Do it!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This app works great. You spend less time figuring out what to do and more time doing the work. I track all of my families cars and it's working wonderfully. Customer service is awesome. I love small companies because they respond to emails and if the user has ideas they are willing to listen. Money well spent.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Stay away.
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Lost my data. This app is garbage.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Customer Support was Great!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I really like this app - it keeps my car maintenance records organized. I recently had a problem logging in and the customer support was great in helping me get my problem solved - even on a weekend late at night. I highly recommend. My account problem was caused by Facebook but the AUTOsist team was able to help me quickly and competently.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Finally!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I’ll try to keep this short.  Tried others with success in only 1 or 2 areas, AUTOsist covers them all.  Best I’ve seen to date.
Love it! super flexible and easy to use.  Missing a field you want? say tire size , just add it.  Love the portal access and export features, means your data isn’t locked away in one place.  Been restoring and tweaking a car and this has been a great way to track my work and look over time what tweaks are working and which ones aren’t.  Being able to add pictures of the work is real nice. To helps you remember.  Support staff is very responsive and helpful.  
Easy entry is key, makes gas fill ups quick to enter.  Does well in this area also.  I could go on. 
Good job guys/gals!!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Misleading
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Free for 1 vehicle they need to be more up front about costs $20 if you have 2 vehicles

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I have been using this app for several months. I also have several cars and do my own maintenance. I really like this app. It is very easy to navigate and really helps me keep track of the maintenance on all my cars. I especially like the fact I can access my information on multiple devices. Well worth the price!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Best, most comprehensive
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This full-featured app is the epitome of elegance. I’ve been using a free app for a long time, but so many tools and functions were missing. When an app is so dependable and flexible, with categories like service, fuel, photos, reminders, and multiple devices, it is worth it. I can even get my wife to use it, so we don’t miss a single fill up or service reminder. And I’m still exploring. Thanks for the support for your product.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Must have
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I can not think of anything this app is missing - the import feature allowed me to easily import 5 years of gas receipts

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Easy to use and organize
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Best app available for keeping track of maintenance and repairs on all your vehicles. Very easy to export into excel and document form.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Disappointed
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I’m disappointed that you can’t access the web portal unless you pay $50.00.  Ridiculous!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Wth
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I lost my info and they found it! What a life saver. All stored in the “cloud.” Great app

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Fantastic
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Keeping track of my the 93 Harley Davidson Fat Boy and 98 Jeep Wrangler is just easy as pie. Love the way the app gives heads up to pending services. Nice to have it all so convenient. Quick response when I have a question or issue. Love this app!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Good for 5 or fewer cars
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
It’s a manual and tedious process to set this up, and if I had 5 or fewer cars, I’d consider it. There is an initial setup that is entirely manual, and that makes this app seem more like a simple organizer and not a tool with magic productivity powers.

I think most people would benefit from the easier Carfax app, which auto-populates a lot of info about your car from just the VIN or license plate. Plus, you can track 8 cars with Carfax for free, while this app costs $ for more than one car. I have 14 cars, and the price for this app isn’t disclosed when you have more than 5 cars. You get the mysterious “click here to learn more” link where they try to soak you. No thanks, deleted.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Had it for months but now it’s just too slow
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Updated version is awesome! Great job!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: The best I have used so far
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
Recently asked tech support for help and they were very quick to reply by email and helped me resolve my issue.

I’m very happy I can have this on both my iPad and iPhone. Pretty user friendly interface and will do what I want it to do.

: )

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Not Worth It
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Basic information can be kept anywhere.  This app ONLY allows for 1 vehicle unless you spend big bucks to upgrade.  Editing of notes is an issue.  Don’t use an apostrophe in naming the vehicle or you’ll get foreign letters built in.  Just a plain terrible app!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App for those that do their own repairs
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I own and work on multiple motorcycles for both street and racing purposes. This app is super handy for keeping track of all purchases for each bike, as well as, keeping important info handy like tire pressures, torque specs, fluid amounts and so on. I recommend the paid version if you have multiple vehicles you’d like to keep track of.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Pretty cool
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
Had some issues with the upgrade, once it was explained that the email address should be used and the phone number was more for fleet customers, the issue was fixed quickly.

Very nice app

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This app is very helpful keeping track of my maintenance on my motorcycle, cars, home. I really like it for reminders like the annual brake fluid flush on my dirt bike and when to replace the whole house water filter. Great app and customer service

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Fantastic app!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Best app for tracking maintenance of vehicles. Worth every penny to upgrade.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: The Best Auto Maintenance app EVER !!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I love this app.  I have been keeping track of my vehicle maintenance for many years using this app.  It’s a great reference tool for when you need to know that last time a specific repair was done on one of your vehicles. I’m a do it yourselfer and use this app any time I work on my cars.  Recently I was shopping for a new lease and so I used this app to calculate my annual miles driven based on the service history I kept on it.  It was spot on.  I use it while shopping for auto parts    I keep a spare tablet in the garage so I can log all repairs while I do them, I then look at it with my iPhone while I am out and about.  I can’t say enough about this app.  stop reading and TRY IT !!  You’ll be glad you did.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: My Favorite App on my iPhone
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This app is AWESOME!  I love being able to have both my wife and I be able to enter data at the same time and immediately see the updates. The latest version is also MUCH faster in updating than the previous version. Ability to work without an internet connection is nice also. Finally, the technical support for the app is INCREDIBLE!  I have never waited more than 15 minutes for a response to an inquiry. Very responsive and helpful. Could not recommend this app more highly!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great Service Awesome App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I have searched for an app that will track, backup, and allow me to add pictures while being easy to user friendly with a clean layout. Boom this is it. I needed additional vehicles on a personal plan reached out and within minutes I had a response and it was resolved. I’m very happy with the service and the app. Great tool.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App and Customer Service
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I’ve been using this app for the past couple years (before that it was pen and paper).  Great way to track my car!  Recently had an issue and reached out to customer service, they responded and resolved the issue quickly!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app to track multiple vehicles in one place.
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I use this app to track all maintenance and work done to all my vehicles, including ones I do not own anymore. I also used this app to transfer maintenance documentation on one of my vehicles I sold to the new owner.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Best tech support ever
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I had an issue finding my vehicles after updating the app. Emailed the tech support folks on a Saturday evening and they promptly responded and had me back up and running by Sunday morning! Very very responsive and helpful!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I have been looking for a good app to keep up with the service records on my cars. Just started using AUTOsist and have been impressed with the app. I had an issue with the syncing between computer & app. I emailed support and received a quick fix.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Good for Tracking
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I always relied on this app to monitor every time I would fill up with gas so I could see what my car was averaging for miles per gallon, it helps me keep track of whether or not I need to service it.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great Customer Service
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
Have used this app for approximately 2 yrs.  Had operated fine until the last update. 
My vehicles disappeared from my phone.  After trying to fix it myself unsuccessfully, I emailed customer service on the 4th of July!  Imagine my surprise when they contacted me back within the hour with a suggested fix, which was done easily  and fixed the issue!  Plus it seems to operate faster.  Would recommend this company without reservation!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great customer support
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I switched from an android phone to an Apple phone and had no problems whatsoever transferring data from one to the other. In fact, it was done seamlessly.
I did however, need to contact product support for help because I wasn’t sure how to handle the restore and backup procedure. Basically all I had to do was download the app and sign in and Bam!  All my data was downloaded instantly. Thank you Autosist for great customer support.
Also, the replies to my emails were within minutes!!! 
If you’re looking for a maintenance app for your vehicle this is the app for you. Great customer service combined with extensive record keeping makes for the perfect auto maintenance app.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app and amazing tech support
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I love this app. So easy to put all my documents in one place, monitor my maintenance needs and keep track of my mileage. I had a log-in problem tonight (9:45 pm), and the tech support solved my problem in about 2 minutes! Great support and great app. Highly recommend!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App and Support
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
This app does a great job of keeping all your auto records in one place. I just switched from another app that I liked, but it hadn’t been updated in several years... This one is great because it works on the iPad too, and syncs data between the two. 

I had a problem logging into the app once I upgraded my iPad, received notice that I had too many devices logged in. Their customer service was prompt and very helpful. All in all this is a great app and I recommend it.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Can’t live without it!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I collect classic cars and I use to have all my data/specs on a dry erase board. It worked great until my collection grew. Came crashing down when I accidentally got the dry erase board wet and erased years of notes. I decided to research an App that would help organize and notify me when oil changes and tire rotations were due. I e-mailed them and they helped customize my App to support all my vehicles. I was also able to file pics of my registration and insurance so EVERYTHING is now available with just a click.

On a side note, I updated my App and I thought I lost all my data. I immediately e-mailed them and received a response within minutes. I simply had to delete and re-install AUTOsist and boom! This is the second time I’ve e-mailed them and they ALWAYS answer you back immediately. I rarely write reviews but I’m very impressed with costumer service and the navigational ease of App. I sincerely appreciate all your help. Thank you!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app with great support
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I love this app!  I forgot my email and couldn’t access any of my data.  The email support was awesome!  They were so quick and were able to retrieve all of my data!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Awesome app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I just got a new CMMS system in the plant I work in and was looking for something like that to use for a diesel pickup I had just purchased - this app is perfect!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App and Services
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I have been using the app for about two months and it’s works great. They had an update and when I updated and I messed up and made a new account instead of updating old account, they were very very helpful in a very timely manner.   
Great product and app. 

Thank you

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Excellent app -!after the redesign
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I have used this app for several years now. Since the redesign fixed the speed issue a few months back, this is an excellent app for doing what it does. I have used several other apps for keeping track of gas mileage and service records but this one is much better than the competition. Support is great too. Great job all around! Very thankful.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Best App Out There
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
Actually have used a ton these apps. I keep track of everything on my vehicles down to the most minuscule items. This app makes it extremely easy.

With the recent update the program has worked better than it ever has. All maintenance can be tracked fuel mileage. Even things such as your insurance and registration. There’s a special part on the app called glove box. Records are backed up online not just on your phone, you could even log on line to see your records. Maintenance intervals can be programmed with in the app as well. And reminders can automatically be sent to you. Hands-down, the best apps out there for this

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Excellent Tracking
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I needed an app to track the maintenance on my vehicles. Found this in the App Store and decided to give it a try. I have had nothing but fulfilled expectations. This app does everything I needed and more, from tracking service to setting reminders it’s got me covered. I submitted a ticket for an issue recently that wound up being user error, not the app, I had a response within the hour! Great support and excellent customer service makes this app 5 stars!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: The updated wiped out my old data
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Overall this is a nice concept; to keep track of maintenance however the recent update cleared out all my previous records, kind of upset 😢

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app for car records!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: A great app to record and manage your auto maintenance! After I had trouble accessing my data (due to my error) their staff “went to the mat” getting me straightened out. Highly recommended!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Excellent customer service
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I have really depended on this app for my car and motorcycle service and mx. I didn’t realize how much I depended on it until I accidentally logged out and forgot which email I used to set up this app. I assumed all of my data was lost. In a last ditch effort, I contacted customer support and within minutes, I was up and running again. AMAZING support team!!! I can’t recommend this app enough!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Crashes
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I just downloaded this app after a verbal recommendation that was confirmed by the online reviews. I was able to start an account, but every time I try to open the app t freezes then immediately shuts down. I uninstalled and reinstalled it and tried it on my iPad with no luck

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Buggy
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Unable to add correct service dates. Every time I put in a date it defaults to current date. Also unable to delete account. Keeps telling me I have no connection. Ridiculous!!!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Nice app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I’ve used this app for a couple years and have been happy with it. There are enough features that allow me to keep track of all things car maintenance and easy to reference. Recently I had to contact them regarding sign in info and they were prompt and helpful.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Essential app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I keep track of my motorcycle maintenance on this app and find it to be very reliable and helpful. I’m going pro and adding my wife’s car. The developer is very active in continually improving the app and keeping on top of bugs. I recommend people try it out then support the dev by purchasing a subscription or pro plan.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Best on the market. By far.
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I’ve never written a review for any company.

The reason I’m writing one for AUTOsist is because I have never experienced such a high level of customer service from an app-based company before. Zorrane, the founder, gave me a call within the first day of trial of the app. He is professional, friendly and clearly knows what he is doing. 

I run a transportation business and am glad I no longer have to deal with paper logs getting lost and having close to zero control over my vehicles. That’s one of 10 reasons I like this company. Give it a trial.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great way to track maintenance
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I used this app to manage my vintage car, motorcycles and generator maintenance. It works great to track the service and I log all the maintenance specs in the notes(torques, oil capacity and types etc.)

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Facebook login cleared data. AUTOsist got it back
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I updated the new version. I am now logged out and don’t remember which username I had since I was logged in with Facebook. I logged into every possible email and all empty garages. I thought I lost all my data from the first 20k miles on my car 😠. AUTOsist helped me get it back and recover the data. Responded with in the hour. New update looks good too

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Recovery
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
After forgetting my password and having changed my email, I could not open the app. Their support@autosist responded to my email request and had be back in the program in a much more timely and efficient manner than I would have ever expected. I was impressed. 

Oh, and the program is great too.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Must Have App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I use this app to track Mx on our Class A including the generator and Aqua Hot System as well as Ram, and Harley.  Easy to use across multiple devices.  The team has done an awesome job on the latest version.  Thank you!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Not the service I was looking for.
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: All I wanted was a digital diary of my records to the expenses of my car, mostly just for the fuel log.  What I get here is a cloud service which might be great for some but what I expected was a digital log kept on my phone.  When I tried logging in after a recent update, all my records have disappeared.  It’s unfortunate but I don’t think I’ll be using this anymore.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Allows me to track all expenses for my two SUV’s. Easy to use.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Much improved- perfect app for car enthusiasts
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: So much better than prior version. Faster and better organized. I like that you can make a dossier (PDF) if you were ever to sell your car. Records organize neatly and searchable.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I use this for my Jeep I got in October 2017. It’s great to track all service and fuel records so I know everything I’ve had done and how my fuel economy is. Also, it shows how much I’ve spent on gas and service. The developers also helped when my account logged out and Facebook blocked my login. Overall I recommend to everyone.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I’ve had this app for about six months or longer. I have stored all of my data on my car in this app. When I went to open it today, it wanted me to re-login, so I did. At first I panicked because I thought everything was gone. But I contacted customer service and they responded within seconds. They were very helpful and help me get my account restored. Beware if you login with the Facebook app it assign some weird email that your aren’t even aware of. Don’t worry just contact customer service and they will help you. I love this app I store all my gas fill ups, I oil changes and any maintenance and service I have done my car it’s wonderful!!!!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Extremely helpful customer service
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: My vehicles showed up missing one day after a software update and CS was able to locate my cars and restore my data in under an hour! Very satisfied with the new look and features as well!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Best Auto Maintenance App EVER!!!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This app does it all!!  Looking to track fuel? Yes, it does it!  Looking to track auto maintenance?  Yes, it does it!  The most in-depth auto maintenance tracking app in the App Store!  The latest version update was much welcomed and it feels like a completely new app!  Even the previous version was much better than any other Auto Maintenance tracking app in the App Store.  Thanks AUTOsist developers for a great app.  Keep up great work and I Lois forward to future updates / enhancements.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: 5 star support team
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Once I upgraded to version 5 it signed me out of my account.. That's fair, except I forgot what I used to sign in (if I did at all)... Used my Google account and saw I had no more cars in my garage. Emailed the support team and they responded super quickly and asked me a couple lines of info and I was able to get my car back and all the data with it. Thank goodness for their quick responses, this team deserves to have their app bought.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Terrible Update
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Upon updating to the new version, i go to re-login to my account and now the app force closes every time I try to use it. Unbelievable. Please fix.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great maintenance app! Easy to use!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I’ve been using AUTOsist for several months and love it. I keep all my fuel fill-ups and preventive maintenance records on this app. It’s much easier than keeping up with receipts. When they updated their app and I had an issue with my data, they fixed it immediately!! Great service! Highly recommend.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Upgrade to 5.0
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
Would put pen to paper to record maintenance and service to my vehicle that I drove for over 10 years, before smart phones were available. So when I upgraded my vehicle and smart phones were available I wanted a more readily available way to maintain my records and this app was my choice.
Really enjoyed having all that info at my fingertips for that vehicle, but then relocated and purchased a new vehicle and started building a good amount of info.
 The other day, upgraded to the 5.0 version and upon logging in, there was my original vehicle that I started this app with, right there in front of me, current vehicle not to be seen. Sure missed the pen and pencil then.
So emailed the developer and through a course of several emails back-and-forth, with suggestions and questions they got me in the ball park and with my answers and their persistence, was able to log in and there sat my current vehicle that I was sure was lost.
I have emailed companies before with queries and was totally ignored. Half expected to have the same thing happen here but was very pleasantly surprised to have a response to my email with sincere questions. So if anyone out there has ran into the same problem with the upgrade don’t throw up your hands and move on, email the developer and they will give you 100% to get you satisfied and back on the road.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Fantastic app & support!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I love this app. The organization is intuitive, and the latest update fixed my only beef, which was the slow load time. The support team is also phenomenal!!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great Customer service and update works well so far!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Solid app. Update works faster and smoother. Customer service replied with an issue I had in under 5 minutes!  They were very helpful and fixed my issue instantly.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I’ve been using AUTOsist for about 7 months. It has always worked well but until the recent update was getting slow to respond. Since the update to Version 5 it is very fast and I’m loving it even more!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App to track repairs and maintenance
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This app is one of my favorites and helps to keep my 2 cars maintained perfectly.  With reminders and fluid GUI, it is so easy to keep track of upcoming maintenance.  Worth every penny as it has paid for itself many times over!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App, Great Features, Great Dev
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I love this app. I’m so glad I stumbled upon it.

I paid for the “middle” level, and it was worth EVERY penny. Keeping records is so easy. With Version 5, it’s super fast.

I love the scanning feature. The fuel consumption is fantastic. So easy to keep such accurate records.

Dev is very responsive to emails and suggestions.

Keep it up!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great customer service!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Seldom do I have problems with AUTOsist, it’s a great app. It does what they say it does and very well indeed, thank you. However on the rare occasion I do have a problem, the customer service department handles it very quickly and efficiently.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Wow! So much faster!!!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
Nice update. So much faster! Speed in previous version was really slow...

This is a great program - fuel & maintenance log work great. And I love the reminders!!!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great way to track service records
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
All login issues fixed as of the latest update. The new design is much easier on the eyes and everything seems to be running faster. 

Thanks to the dev team for working with me on my login issues, this team is great.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Nice features! The update is great!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I like the new look and the new updates are great. I use this app to keep track of all my service records for my Focus RS and Lexus F sport. I log everything service and fuel wise. Perfect all in one app to keep records of your vehicles.  If you create an account you can view your records through a web browser online and you can also back up your data. The customer service responds super fast!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: New life!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Such a breath of fresh air! Just was I was waiting for. A redesign! It’s looking great and it feels snappier.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Very Relevant App!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I have five vehicles, and bought the Pro Level (previously good for five auto’s).   I have used this app for about two months, and I already feel better about my maintenance schedule.  I first went to my owner’s manual, and input all the standard maintenance items, at the suggested intervals. The app tracks them based on mileage or time, and suggests action.

Prior to this update, you used to separately have to enter the completed action in the service folder. Now as I understand it, when you complete a standard maintenance item, the information automatically populates into the service folder. Fabulous!

Also like that you can email or text the service history to anybody, especially convenient when you sell the car.

Most importantly, their customer service response to emails is fabulous!  They have usually responded to me within hours.

I am very optimistic this app is going to be all I need to service my vehicles. Thanks for the new release!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Good for auto records
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
Great for keeping track of the work done to your car.
Support was fast and helpful in resolving a problem I was having getting a record entered.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Love the app. Even better after improvements
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: So I've used this app for about a year and have loved it. Easy to use and simple interface. My only complaint was it was a tad slow and unresponsive at times. This was 100% fixed with their latest update. It is now fast and responsive and I honestly have no complaints. Easy 5 star rating and would recommend to anyone.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Love this app!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: For years I’ve kept a logbook in my car and transferred data to a spreadsheet. This automates this beautifully and is really easy to use. I love that I can store PDF docs and photos and export my data easily to a spreadsheet. Great app guys!!!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great Update
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: The speed is amazing!  Love the new look and quickness.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Update
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Updated the app today. Can no longer log in. Works if you go direct to the website but not via the app.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Almost Conplete
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: No cloud (Cloud Drive, Dropbox, Box) service integration. Calendar integration

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Five star service

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Needs some UI optimization
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
It’s a very useful app, but. 

The most frequent task: record a fuel-up. 

Takes 4 taps after launch, and the app is so slow it’s painful. Often it takes more than 4 taps because it won’t recognize some. And I’m using it on an iPhone X so there’s absolutely no hardware reason it should be slow. 

3D Touch directly into a new gas entry would be very welcome. 

Also would be helpful to be able to use location services to record my current location with each service and gas stop, instead of updating the Notes section each time. 

And taking photos is similarly on need of UI improvements. Several taps including an editing interface that I rarely need. Why not allow editing after the fact for the rare time I want to rotate or crop a photo instead of forcing me to interact with that screen every time?

And each time I add gas I’m curious about my mileage, but when I tap “done” I’m told it was successful via a modal pop up (another tap) and then I have to tap yet another time to get to the list of fuel-ups to see my mileage. Why doesn’t it eliminate both unnecessary taps and just take me to the full list when I tap done?

Robust app but a very poor user experience.
