AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Disappointing
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Good idea, responsive support, but the app just doesn't do math well.  Often it can't compute the mpg, even though the data is there.  I don't like that the data is stored in their server not because if privacy, but because it means it's slow or u available in rural locations where there is no internet.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Luv it
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Works very well on iPhone with multiple vehicles

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Highly Recommend This App!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I’ve been managing my family’s vehicles with a home grown spreadsheet over the years and knew there was an easier and better way of recording maintenance and tracking expenses, so I began searching for a desktop and mobile application to track these things for our cars, and I came across AUTOsist (after using a few others along the way) and can’t tell folks enough how glad I am that I found AUTOsist. Not only do I get to track maintenance and costs, but now have reminders email me when things are due, like safety inspections or oil changes. I am also able to store important documents & receipts, and have access to everything on both the mobile and desktop app. Makes it quite handy to have a scanned or photographed receipt in the database from an earlier repair when at the mechanic shop so they can see the date and repairs made if needed. So, the app is awesome. Best of its kind. But there’s one more thing I never realized I would get with this app – customer support. The folks behind AUTOsist have been quite responsive in not only providing new enhancements to their tool, but also supporting me when I have had issues (only two issues which entailed (1) initial setting up vehicle pictures which was my user error, and (2) assistance with importing records in), and when I say support, I mean terrific support – fast, efficient and they work till it gets resolved and follow up to make sure you are happy. Now that’s service. HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS PRODUCT. (Disclaimer: I have no connection to this application or developers other than being a normal user of their product, and this is my own individual review and will surely validate that).

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great record keeper
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: So far it's great and keeps all my records current.  Nice to know when I changed my oil last.  I do all my maintenance myself.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: I don't usually write reviews
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I don't usually write reviews but the customer service I received from AUTOsist made me do it. We recently purchased the Plus account but even though my credit card was charged Apple still did not reflect the change in account status a couple days later. I contacted support and within 10 minutes they had me upgraded. They were very professional and responsive. Definitely will recommend this app to anyone.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Does what it says!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
Just a great easy to use app for DIYer's to keep track of auto maintenance.  The ability to take photos of parts next to the car is a plus in case warranty work is needed.

I had a small problem upgrading.  The developer resolved within an hour of my e-mailing.  So great support too!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app! Use it for all my cars!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I've been using this app for a year now. It's a great way to stay up on all the the normal yet very important maintenance of my two cars. Also support is incredibly responsive and very helpful! Great app and Great Developers!!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Awesome App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I do all my own work on my cars/trucks/motorcycles. I have tried many vehicle maintenance apps and Autosist has been the best one I have ever used. It helps me keep track of all my maintenance and I don't have to keep a notebook in each vehicle like I used to back in the day. Love being able to look on my phone and get all the info I need on any vehicle at anytime. Thanks guys and keep up the good work!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Report Issues
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: The service history report is flawed, in that if you add more than one image/photo to a single service record, it will only show, in the report, one image/photo, and not all images associated with the service history report.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Awesome App!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
Update 3/31/207: Developers fixed the issue. It's working as designed. Great app! I love it! The developers contacted me and apologized for the inconvenience. You don't see customer service like that anymore. 

I have all the records for my three vehicles and I can't even open it. The icon loads and dies right there. It was working fine and it is a good app, but... how good an app could be if you can even access it?

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Good app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Responded to an issue I had. Will be checking out app again.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great for Tracking car stuff
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I have only used the gas / mileage log which has been great to have it all in one place.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: AWESOME!!!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I highly recommend this app if you want to keep track of your gas mileage and expenses, services, upcoming reminders for service, and more, and it's FREE!!!  If I had more than one car I'd pay for the upgrade.  And even though it's free, customer service was INCREDIBLY quick and responsive when I needed to change my email.  We worked back-and-forth, got it fixed, and they were GREAT!!!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: AUTOsist-Tops in features, ease of use and Efficient Customer Support
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I am a fairly new user of AUTOsist and had made a few errors in my filing positions. I contacted them and they got back to me almost immediately and resolved my errors from their side and got my files in the categories I requested. They also were very interested in my views regarding my thoughts about pricing on their different plans and were very responsive to that, also.   I have many apps but thus far have never had any customer service for any app be more responsive and efficient than those at AUTOsist. Can't go wrong with this one!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Amazing!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This app saves all my receipts and generated reports. After entering all my information I saw that a local shop was doing work that wasn't needed. I always have my car information at hand now!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Exceptional support
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Bought the app and been using it last four months. Suddenly entered wrong mileage and could not adjust it in the app. Sent email to support and had response in under fifteen minutes followed by multiple emails over the next 45 minutes until they corrected the mileage from their side while apologizing for the inconvenience. Highly recommend the product as well as the product support.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Does it all
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Been researching car maintenance apps for a while, this is the only one that has all the features. It does the normal stuff like reminders and service tracking, but also gives you reports, let's you photograph receipts, and has a digital glove box of documents that correspond with your car. I have also dealt with their customer service, they are excellent, had answers to my questions and less than 30 minutes. It is pricier than other apps, but worth it for the receipt photos alone. Try this app out.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Autoist
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Very good App for tracking and logging auto expenses

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Incredible Customer Service
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I downloaded and installed AUTOsist today and was pleased to see that I could import data from the app I'd been using for years.  I had a few problems importing the data and emailed customer support. They answered all my questions quickly and got me up and running with all the data for my car.  

I'm excited to begin using the app on a daily basis, knowing that the outstanding customer service team will be there if I need them.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great Tracker
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I was an avid user of TealAuto "back in the day" (Palm platform) and was able to convert all my old data via the .csv upload on this app's great online "companion" cloud interface.  The entry is easy and the picture capture for any fuel or service is a bonus. 

This app is for you if you like to track your gas purchases and service records in an easy-to-enter, calculate, and find way. 

Also, I contacted the developer with a minor question and got an immediate and very helpful response.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great tool to manage vehicle
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This app helps me to stay organized with all the records of my car. Love that I can access records anytime on any of my devices. Highly recommend!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Good App for vehicle management
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Nice app! I recently purchased for my two cars. Once you add new information, it is uploaded to the web, that means if even you delete the app form ur phone, all information about my cars are still on the webpage. Another feature i am fond of is you can generate reports of each category, service and fuel usage and etc. fairly good app.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Excellent complete Tracker
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Autosist is a great tracking program and app. I was looking for a complete program with easy input. This app gives you the versatility to enter while at the pump and also enter on the web. The customer service is super friendly and quick to respond. Great operation!!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Very useful and user-friendly
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Excellent app for tracking mpg and for documenting all service types. I also love that I can remind myself when future services are due, which eases the burden of having to remember what and when I was supposed to take care of for upcoming maintenance and tune-up needs.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App!! You must get this one!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Love that this app lets you track service and gas mileage! I am always forgetting what service I did and now it remembers for me. Easy to use, easy to update.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Lots of help keeping my car maintenance tracked!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Disappointed
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I'm totally willing to pay for a good or great app. However, an additional $9.99 to archive/inventory a second vehicle? $19.99 for a third? $29.99 for a fourth?
RUFKM?!
That's just straight up GREED. 
The app seems quite robust (cloud storage, photos, lots of areas for anything related to a vehicle). 
However, that also results in too many choices and too many categories to enter something simple like oil/filter change and tire rotation. 
In addition, it doesn't allow for quick entry of repeated services, i.e. Oil/filter and tire rotation must be re-typed each entry, as if it was the first time each time. 
PITA, especially for $4.99, then additional $9.99 for each vehicle. 
NO THANK YOU. 
An app called "Car Care" is much better and more user friendly.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I love this app! I was tasked with managing 4 vehicles and two trailers and this app has made it very simple for me to do so. It does everything I need it to. It is very user-friendly. I highly recommend it! And customer service is super fast to respond. They respond almost immediately if I ever have a question.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: A Must HAVE app!!!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This app is everything you need to keep track of auto records! It makes my life SO MUCH EASIER!!! This app is so good, it can't even compare to other car maintenance apps out there, it beats them all!!! Once u download it, u will agree u can't live without it !

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: After trying many other apps this one is the best hands down. It keeps records of everything with a nice interface and you can access online without the app. It even shows recalls if any for your vehicle. I even upgraded to unlimited storage even though 100 entries is a lot for basic. This is a must have app for anyone who wants to track vehicle maintenance.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Good Lord. Can I track the cost of this app as a service fee on my cars?
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This app is perfect for what I want to do and seems to be the only one in the App Store that allows you to take and store pictures of receipts.  I love that.  The user interface is easy to work and the app over all is just good.  But mercy, I can replace the transmission for about the same cost as this app.  With 3 family vehicles, I would have to pay $20 to do what most of the other apps do for $4.99 plus take a picture.  For that money I think I will have to use another app and just created a folder in my photos app for storing vehicle receipts.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Drivers
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I've tried several auto maintenance apps, and this one is far and away the BEST. I love all the features. I wish it wasn't so expensive to add a car, but it really is worth the extra money. It'll be so nice not having to dig through all our paper receipts to locate a specific service we had done. Great customer service too.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App for our Family
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I drive about 500 miles a week for my job --add that to the mileage my husband and teenage son rack up and we end up with significant mileage each week. AutoAssist allows us to track our gasoline expenditures and the maintenance in one location for our entire family. I'm a big fan!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Very Pleased!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I have been very happy with the app. It more then meets my needs!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Exactly what I was looking for!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
Perfect app to keep track of Car maintenance records and set up reminders. 
Sent request to change my email address bound to AUTOsist account and received reply within half hour. Highly recommend!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I've been looking for an App that can do what this does for over a year and am so glad I found it! Works very smoothly and the online reports are amazing, I'm using the fleet version after starting with the free version and seeing just how valuable it is!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Great

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Working the bugs out but lots of cool features, great support too!!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: A+
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: The best out there if you keep up with your record keeping!!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
Best app for keeping track of your vehicle maintenance. Sends me reminders when its time to change the oil or rotate the tires. These are just a few awesome features with this app.
Costumer support is also incredible.  Had a small issue and they responded within minutes with a clear explanation. 
If you have one car or many, this app is for you.

Dave Gates

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Best auto maintenance app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: AUTOsist is the best app I have found to record data for your vehicle. One thing that it allows you to do that no other app lets you do is that you can export your service records which is very valuable if you're trying to sell your vehicle. In addition to that, I contacted customer support and I got a response in about 30 minutes. We went back and forth about 10 emails and every time they responded faster than I did. Great customer service and great app.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Love the fuel and maintenance record keeping ability

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Works great!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I downloaded it so I could track my gas usage/mileage and it works perfectly.  I enter; gallons, price, mileage and it calculates mpg and keeps a record of it for tax purposes.

I haven't used it for anything else, but it's working for me.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Awesome App!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This app is the perfect tool to keep track of all your vehicle maintenance information. Simple to use and looks very clean. Also tech support is fast, friendly and efficient.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: The Best of All I've Tried
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: It packs it all in, service & fuel legs, scheduled service, important documents.  Very logical with clear UI.  I had one question & reached out to help.  They responded within 15 minutes with helpful advice.  App also provides a printable analysis report on service/fuel expenses. Absolutely fantastic!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Best maintenance app out there!!!  Definitely recommended if you need a simple way to keep track of things like maintenance, fuel, and other important records.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great for my Fleet
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I use this to track my fleet maintenance and it's a great management tool.  I have over 50 trucks and this is a simple and affordable tool.  Highly recommended!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Fantastic Vehicle Maintenance App!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I own 6 vehicles and it has been impossible for me to keep track of the maintenance and basic info (plate #, VIN, etc.).  This app is awesome for that.  I haven't even taken advantage of the reminders yet but definitely already getting my money's worth.  I've tried other apps and deleted them - they don't come close to what AUTOsist can do!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Tons of features!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I'm not a fleet manager, nor do I need to log miles or gas for any business purpose. I'm just a guy who loves my vehicles and likes to keep all the details in one clean place. This app has helped keep my glove boxes clean from piles of papers of service records, registrations and so on. I'm also able to get an extremely accurate MPG reading for my vehicles from the gas logging feature. I wish I had started using this app when my car was new, to keep a perfect record of all service and maintenance...but maybe next time around. I'm a big fan of AUTOsist, while the UI has a little ways yet to go, the multitude of features this app boasts puts it far above its competitors in my book. 5 stars for a great app that everyone should really have and use.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great upgrade app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Tried some other similar apps. When I decided I wanted to upgrade and actually keep track of things like what parts were used or what the actual paperwork said, this was the only app to choose. The support is also top notch, for any problems you encounter or no matter how odd your situation is. For these prices, it's a no-brainer!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Perfect!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I am able to do everything that I want to with this app and now with the export feature I have no risk of loosing such important information. I emailed them with a feature suggestion and they responded immediately and within a few months the feature was available AND they emailed me to follow up on the feature. Thanks AUTOsist!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Useful
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Useful app - recommend for those who actually care about the well being of their ride. With every update huge improvements are made to this app. It's one of those must have apps - I even got my wife to use it!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Nice
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I have tried a number of these maintenance type apps and am quite pleased with this one.  Provides the same basic functions as the others, but has two nice features that set it apart.  The first is the web portal.  That's nice for entering long notes or lots of service data on a keyboard; and you still have the mobile device for reminders and fuel ups.  The second is the support.  So far, they have been great! Fast and helpful.

If they get the data import function working, that will really set this one apart.  In my opinion, it would be the best one out there at that point.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great for a dad!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Got this to help me track upkeep on my daughters car and upgraded so I can track everyone in the family. Easy to setup and use!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Good app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: It works well for tracking my gas usage and maintenance. It would be nice if you could set the fuel efficiency unit separately from the distance and fuel units. I have a car that measures miles, but we use liters to measure fuel. It would be nice to see my fuel efficiency in MPGs or Km/L.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Excellent
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
Great app. Had an issue running report. They were very responsive and kept be abreast of the repair, which they corrected. 
Would like to see additional reports that would break down cost of repairs and maintenance.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Should be more free vehicles
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: There should be more then one vehicle that is included in the free version

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great features, easy to use
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I just upgraded to the pro after using this for several months.  Love the ability to attach photos to each service.   My new go to app for vehicle tracking. Customer support was super friendly and fast response.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Perfect!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
This is the app I have been waiting for, forever!  All in one place: all the stuff I need to keep record of for my cars and bikes......with just exactly what I need, and nothing I don't!

I LOVE your app, folks! Thank you.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app and support
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I've been using the app to track gas mileage, maintenance, and accessories purchased for a new scooter and car for about three months now.  Easy to use and export your data.  

I contacted support when I first installed the app because I couldn't enter past gas purchases, it want a huge deal since I could work around it by just entering everything in order.  

Just got an email saying they've now updated the app to allow this, so 5 stars for customer support and keeping users updated on issues they've had.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Nice App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Really like being able to manage multiple vehicles both service and fuel. Been trying to do with spreadsheet but app is much easier

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great program for mileage and gas tracking
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I mostly needed a program to allow me to track my gas usage and mpg and this program does it easily and accurately. I love the simple access to the fuel tracker and the option to track other expenses if I choose to. Very easy to use and just what I needed.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app & Customer Service
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I've had a couple of questions on how to do something with great and fast response!  Took advantge of thier Black Friday Deal and asked for a change on my account. Done in minutes and securely. App has been great and user friendly.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Love it!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: My go to app for minding my  vehicle maintenance and fuel economy! I only wish we could break down the fuel economy by "trip".

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Love the functionality; deign is OK
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I have used this app minimally, but it fills a need for me of being able to track car repairs such in a place that won't get lost or detroyed - and even better, are always with me. I like that you can scan recepits so you can have all your records ready to turn over in the event of selling your car. I also fail to remember my license plate numbers with confidence due to needing them so infrequently. This app is nice for many reasons. 
Just today I decided to pay to upgrade to have a second vehicle tracked. 

I docked the 1 star because the design of the app is not as polished (or at least not as consistent with other Apple apps) as I would expect for the price they are charging. They get away with it because it offers cross platform compatabilty, which is wonderful, but I think the design does detract from the overall feel of the app.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: A great app for managing your vehicles
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Though the interface feels a bit dated, this app is pretty awesome for managing your vehicles. Not only can I keep track of my fuel consumption, but I'll never forget a maintenance milestone again. There's even a web interface available. You won't regret using this app.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Just what I needed
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I've been looking for some sort of program to track my vehicles. This app does all I need it to. Highly recommend

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Help on Thanksgiving Eve
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
This App is highly recommended by me and I may be nobody to all you out there but if you have a car or motorcycle you NEED to have this App! 
It tracks everything to keep you vehicle safe and running great!
It alerted me to a recall for my car before the maker did!!
It tracks you service appointments along with reminders!
Great App, Great Service and support!
Carly M.
NY

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Support is key!!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I have used several auto maintenance apps and this one does what I need!! The key is when I have a question or suggestion, will someone be around to answer it! These guys rock the support! Looking forward to offline use!! You can't go wrong and I upgraded to 10 vehicles!!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great for my business fleet
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I use this for my personal car but also for my fleet of trucks for my landscaping business.  It really helps me keep better track of things like oil changes, tires, and other important routine maintenance.  Also great to track gas/fuel and other important record.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Awesome App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I began using this about two months ago and have been pleased so far. I only wish I would have been using this years ago. It's nice having all my maintenance records in one place with copies of receipts. I have been using Scannable to scan the receipts which is a little easier. Over all it's a great app.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Nice
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Awesome app

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Finally an app that does it all
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
What a well thought out and well executed app.    Plenty of bells and whistles but simple enough to use and keeps all the info data in one place.     Didn't take me long to see the value in upgrading to plus so I can keep both our vehicles organized on here.    Makes it so easy to find and share info, track spending, keep up services registrations etc.

And their customer service is really quick and friendly.      I hope they can maintain all this when they grow, which they deserve to do.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I have been using AUTOsist for over a month. I sat down and added all my vehicle records up to date.  It is very simple to use and stores files as PDF and JPG. You can scan your receipts and invoice directly from the app, as well as other documents, that you can store in the “Glove Box”. I used the glove box for anything related to my vehicle. I scanned my VIN tag, my locking lug nut serial number, AAA, Insurance, and many other information that would be helpful. I love it so much I upgraded to Plus for a small price for more storage. It is hands down an awesome app. I had a question for customer service, they responded quickly. It come in so handy when I go to a dealer to order something that specific to my vehicle and I can whip out my VIN from AUTOsist.  Also using it to track my fuel cost. I highly recommended, this is a must-have app if you own a vehicle.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Very Helpful App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: App is stable and mostly no glitches on iPhone6. I use it to help me keep track of my turbo car. Oil changes come every 1,500mi and the app is pretty accurate when reminding me, in addition to other reminder.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App!!!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Easy to use and very resourceful.  Great job AUTOsist Team!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App, Minor Interface Issues
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
This is a great app for tracking your refuels, mileage, and most importantly, repair history, all in one app. It intelligently calculates MPG for you based on fillups, and it's fairly easy to enter data on a smartphone. It even has a web portal, and allows for exporting of data, so it's easy to access info from anywhere, and even hand a complete record to a new vehicle owner. 

The iOS app has a couple of interface issues, though - the icon is not very pretty, and the app appears to have not been updated to support 6/6+ screen sizes. Everything is ridiculously huge-sized on my iPhone 7 Plus.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great functionality
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
Overall works well and pleasant to use. 

Free functionality is sufficient so far & works well. Gas fill ups calculate mpg each time & overall average- nice feature. UI is functional but seems scaled weird & large on iPhone 6+. Adding a personalized car picture is a nice touch.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Excellent
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I have been using this app for almost 2 years. It is excellent to keep and maintain your vehicle records and it also helps if you have record when you go to sell your vehicle.
  AUTOsist team has great customer service and was there to answer all my questions within minutes. Thanks AUTOsist for a great app!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: AWESOME!!!!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: One word....AWESOME!!!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Easy to use and powerful
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I tried a few apps to keep track of registration, insurance and inspection sticker for my two vehicles. This app is the best, easy to use and is capable of much more. The best feature is that it also has a web portal, so that my info is available from any computer even if I lose my phone! I've upgraded now to keep track boats, trailers and even my daughter's car. Everything is organized and kept in one place.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great Features
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Application is great. I drive a lot for work and this is so simple and easy to use. I am able to keep track of all my records at a click of a button! You will save so much time with this application.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Love this app!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This app will let you keep record of all your car maintenance records including millage, dates, shops and costs. Your vehicle data is kept online. Very useful, reliable and simple tu use. I've been using it for more than two years and works like a swiss watch.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great records app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
I really like what you are doing with this app. Probably more than I personally need but I like it all anyway. Nice to see recalls from Edmonds. Wish it was narrowed done to my vin instead of all of Toyota but you can't do anything about that. 

I like your app enough to upgrade to pro even though I didn't really need to. Keep up the good work.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Pick This App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This is the app you want. The customer support team are absolutely amazing and I couldn't be happier with an automobile app!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Awesome app and customer service!!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This is really an awesome app for vehicle maintenance.  I keep all my documents in the apps "glovebox", all service receipts, repair records and everything that used to be kept in an envelope in my trucks glovebox.  I had an issue with the fuel tracker after a fill-up and emailed them once I got home.  Within 2 minutes I got a reply from them that they would fix it!  It was literally 10 minutes and they had it fixed and wanted to confirm it was working right.  They also asked for my iOS version to try and get ahead of any other bugs with the new version I have.  This is the most responsive customer service I have ever dealt with!  A++.  You will love this app if you track fuel mileage and vehicle maintenance.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Excellent Car Maintenance Record Keep & Immediate Support if Ever Needed!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
This is the greatest most effective way to keep track of maintenance records for all the cars in my collection! Allows for everything you might need to keep track of, including pix!

And if you ever need support, it was immediate in my experience. The only issue I've ever had was when migrating from iPhone 6s to 7. Turns out a delete & reinstall solved it.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Basic user
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Enjoying this app to keep track of maintenance records on car

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Love it
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I really love this app, its very useful must download

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Perfect Auto Assistant App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Great App for having all my auto receipts in one place. I'm able to look up when I did my last oil change (place, price, and mileage) and other services. Stores all my auto information like registration, insurance, radio & gps codes, and filter numbers. My battery died last week and it SO helpful to have the codes so handy. This App is awesome.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app to keep car records
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Simple and handy app to keep all your car repair and maintenance records digitally and at the palm of your hand. Really handy and simple to use

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Useful
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
Highly recommend!! 

Very convenient. Even though both my vehicles are fairly new and fully maintained by the dealer, I still use the app to keep all my records consolidated and accessible at my fingertips. Instead of having to go back through my files and look for what's been done vs. what needs to get done, I can check our records at anytime from anywhere. Simply love it!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great and by far the most useful app!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: If you love to buy and sell cars or just want to simply make sure you keep all of your data organized for your vehicles all in one place, this APP is a MUST HAVE!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This is a very useful app and highly recommend.  Lots of great features!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great Tracker
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This is the best tracker I've used.  Great support too.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Fleet owner of 70 vehicles
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I had been searching for a way to track issues and repairs to my personal vehicles and work fleet. This has been great to use. I wish it had a csv backup I could download for piece of mind as I'd be devastated to lose everything I've entered into this program. The support has been great in making changes so far. Highly recommended!!!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Love it!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This app has made tracking for my car maintenance so much easier! New update is awesome! 👍🏼

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great for classic car owners, too...
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: A very handy app, It proved to be fairly easy to enter info and upload receipts. Installation and operation were flawless. Interface is clean and intuitive. Search function is particularly useful ("When did I have my radiator fixed?").

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Excellent app!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I am very pleased with AUTOsist so far.  The customer service is nothing short of fantastic--I receive replies in minutes; not even hours or days!  I am transitioning from another auto records logging app and am finding this one more intuitive and will likely provide better planning for maintenance.  The upgrade allowed me to have multiple vehicles which was a plus.  The developer is very active and will be introducing useful enhancements soon.  My other happ hasn't been touched in three years and is feeling dated--AUTOsist is fresh and feature "moderate" (you won't get lost in too many features).  Great app!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Simply the best!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Got this specifically to keep track of my Harley info. I love how quick, easy, and accurate it is! I'll be upgrading to the Plus Account to do my other vehicles as well. Great job!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: All-in-all a useful tool thus far.
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Intuitive app covering the basics of maintenance documentation and record keeping. I'd like to see the ability to import native or cloud pdf docs in addition to the limited photo library upload / picture taking option. Integration with "camscanner" would be great. Also, bluetooth connection allowing vehicle I.D. and auto update for vehicle vitals would put this app out in front.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great Service and fuel Record
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Love the fact I can download the app and sign into any devices and have all the records saved and accessible. It's so good, I installed into my mom's phone and have her log her records!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Very easy to use app for keeping up with auto repairs and maintenance. Not only does it keep the data, but you may also scan your receipts and service tickets for archiving. *****

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App, easy to use
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Have had for several months and will be upgrading to Pro Account to track all our vehicles.  Able to have everything in one app instead of multiple apps.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
AUTOsist is a great app.   I use it to track the maintenance records for all of my vehicles.  I love having the records right at my fingertips!

I would highly recommend this app to anyone who is looking to take their vehicle maintenance records paperless.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Money grab
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Have to give email and verify to activate account, and can only do one vehicle in "free" version. Certainly not a standalone app

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Nice app!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Recently upgraded to a smartphone, and have been adding useful apps to simplify a lot of tasks. Keeping track of auto expenses had been by tossing receipts into a folder or the glovebox. I really like this app! I've been using the free version up until now, but am going to upgrade to get all my vehicles added. One thing I would like to see, is the ability to insert/attach a .pdf file to the notes; I pull oil samples right before every other oil change, and send in for analysis, and the results are emailed in .pdf form.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Good record keeping app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Clean interface and easy to record my fuel ups. Was using this free version for a new car and I'm looking forward to upgrade to also track my wife's.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Finally!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: ... An app that allows vehicle performance and maintenance tracking! Thank you AUTOsist.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Almost there
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I've had this app for the past few months and it ha been getting better and better, particularly with the addition of the gas mileage tracker. Just bought the paid version when it stopped being a yearly fee and instead was a one time thing. The only thing I wish it did was let you add service and fuel ups while in offline mode, then let you sync with the server once you have connectivity again. The way GasCubby does, which I have been using for years, and probably the only reason I still have it.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Clutter free
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I like keeping records of my maintenance and other vehicle expenses. But I don't like keeping paper copies of services or log in a notebook. This app is simple to update with my service history. No clutter. Always with me.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: This awesome app tracks everything maintenance related and more
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I use this app to not only track oil and filter changes, but also when I add accesories to my truck. Works great and is extremely easy to use. Simple yet very effective app.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: New but cool so far
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I'm new to the app but so far it seems to have everything that I need. Looking forward to continued use!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Everything in one place
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I used to keep track of this information via a folder I kept in the car and put receipts in. Eventually it got too bulky and difficult to look through. With this, not only is that issue moot but I now have the information anywhere I am. Great app!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great Car Maintenance App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I checked a bunch of apps out.  This one is awesome.  I have recommended to friends and family.  It is easily worth the fee they charge and they responded to my emails quickly when I had questions.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Finally an auto app that does every I need!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
Finally an auto app that does every I need!  3 cars, boat and trailer... I've got detailed photos of each at my fingertips including those specialized products I can never remember.  Part numbers, product labels, receipts, dates etc.  I no longer have to spend time researching what that product/part was I purchased 3 years ago.  The ability to access info on all of my vehicles from anywhere is awesome.  Plus I set up reminders so maintenance or registrations are no longer a guessing game.
I'm restoring an old 1956 trailer so when I run across parts out and about I think would be cool I have my photos with measurements right here with me so I know immediately if they'll work.

This app is a no brainier!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Awesome Software
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Good app to have for free if you want to organize the car maintenance records. Very easy to use.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Well worth the price for any car buff
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I picked up this app to be as meticulous as possible in tracking records for my 2004 MazdaSpeed Miata. It has been even better than I expected. I track every receipt and fill-up, and can't wait to impress my next buyer someday at how well organized everything is. Ultimately, this small investment in the app will surely increase the resale value of my vehicles!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Good!!!!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I really like this app to keep tracking on my big truck.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This is the best app (Windows or Mac) I have ever used for recording maintenance and fuel information. Easy to set up and easy to use. They provide great customer support. Could not be happier with this app.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Worth it! Very useful.
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Use it for all my maintenance on my car. You can really keep a detailed log of everything that is done to your car and can include pictures to prove the maintenance was done. Great app plus it's FREE! 😁

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Great product. All vehicles in one place

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Good Stuff
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Works great. Needs backup to Dropbox.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Easy fast reliable

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Disappointed
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Does not allow you to backdate repair dates and such.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Cool app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Really good tool to keep track of al ur services n expenses on all vehicles in the palm of your hand.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Love it!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I love using this app! It has everything I e been looking for to keep track of all expenses for my car.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Fantastic app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Aside from mail and message prob the app I use the most. Fantastic and def gives you another perspective on your vehicle allowing that can be easily missed. What's best is that you can always take notes on what want to get done eventually and set reminders from what you need to get done directly from inputting recent service. The mpg feature is fantastic. Again, just an all around great, well thought out app.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Works great
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: App works great just wish you could enter more than 25 updates without having to pay for it. It is very useful app and very easy to navigate.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Worth every penny
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Not sure why some people complain about paying for this app?  You spend more on a fast food meal everyday and this provides much more value.  Great job to the developers.  Amazing tool!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Just What I Needed!
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Very simple and easy way to keep COMPLETE records and maintenance schedules. Even has reminders, and gas mileage section. I tried the free version for about two weeks...and kept emailing with every little question. Every email was answered promptly and courteously. After I was satisfied, I upgraded to a higher number of autos for the entire family. We love the app. Haven't found anything yet that I wish it did that it doesn't already do...except maybe wash the car for me! Ha! I highly recommend this app.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Poor
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Deleted app. Not intuitive. Can only store 25 pieces of info for 1 car. If you need more, you need to buy subscription.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Only 25 records allowed in free version
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Not cool. Removed app

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Looks great but subscription required?
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
This app looks outstanding at a glance. I set up one vehicle in the free app with full intentions of buying the paid version. 

I was shocked to see there is no "paid app". You must continually pay each year as a service.  No thanks. I would have gladly paid even $10-$20 for a good app. Paying that yearly...no. I deleted the app. :/

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Car service app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This is a great app for the price. My car is under warranty but I service it. This keeps great records for me vv

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Love this app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body:
This app is such an improvement to the spreadsheets and folders I had previously. 

I only wish the fuel page had an option for the octane of the gas.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Excellent App/Excellent Customer Service
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This app records and runs a report for all servicing for a fleet of vehicles...however, the most impressive thing about this app is the customer support; they're always there...do keep up the good work!!!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I love this app and use it daily for my business but i am still waiting for it to go portrait mode, i use it mostly on my ipad and it is second to none in my opinion. If you are reading this and wondering if it's right for you, go ahead and get it, you won't regret it, i didn't. Great app.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Keeps getting better !
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Started with them when it first came out and it has been nothing buy improvements since day one I just learned that I can use Windows 7 too. This Co. Is going to go somewhere they are always there to help you and the services are great Check it out you will not be disappointed .  Try it

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Scam
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Hey developers, be upfront about what they get in the free version! Make sure you tell them that you will collect their email BEFORE you tell them this.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Misleading
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: In the description for this app, it says "Manage multiple cars, trucks, motorcycles..." No where does it mention that you will need to upgrade to a paid $10 version to do so. Typical bait and switch.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Amazing App
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This app makes tracking of your auto repairs so easy and generates a great report.  It's so helpful having it at your fingertips. Well worth every penny!

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Perfect
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I love it. Easy to use, helps tremendously for tax purposes, too. Just wish the report was a little more streamlined to print fuel receipts etc more efficiently; wastes a lot of paper as is. Especially like the web portal so I can add info/print from my PC.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great tool and support
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Easy to use site and great support help on my question- keep up good work.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Way to improve
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I originally rated this app a one star and since then their customer service has tried to and certainly has improved everything. They contacted me to address my concerns and also improved the app and now I love it. The one suggestion I would make is to be able to breakdown the gas costing to monthly just to have someone budget better.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: Just what I was looking for.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Fantastic, practical tracking of vehicles
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: I'm the go-to guy for car maintenance for 8 cars. Keeping track was difficult until I found AUTOsist. It lets us track state inspections and registrations in one place. Oil changes, gas mileage as well as filter replacements, brakes and tires. I enjoy this app - super easy and transferring records to a new owner is a breeze. They also respond to questions right away.

AUTOsist Fleet Management.title: Great app
AUTOsist Fleet Management.body: This app provides an easy place to keep track of service receipts, fuel and any notes about the vehicle you have. I was attracted to the app as it includes a large range of vehicle makes including Ural. The developers keep making upgrades based on user feedback and respond quickly to any questions or issues. A well thought out app.
